**[1] Ohio is now the ONLY toss-up Senate race** in the country according to Sabato's Crystal Ball – meaning, if we lose, Democrats will lose control of the Senate.

**[2] Republicans have outspent us 3-to-1** to smear me on the airwaves with nasty and false attack ads and prop up my MAGA opponent, Bernie Moreno.

**[3] I'm afraid it's working: A new poll shows I'm trailing** Moreno by 2 points – right as early voting kicks off.

So much is at stake – and if you know me, you know that I don't count on dark money from billionaires like my opponent. body:
Our answer to these brainwashed, willfully ignorant, wannabe-cultists can't be just words. It must be through our actions: expanding access to the ballot, increasing voter participation, and swelling the voter rolls with newly registered citizens.
RUSH $25 or more right now to protect voting rights and to make every vote count in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101024_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=101024_3&amount=25]
Nothing is ever good enough for opponents of voting rights.
If the ballots are counted quickly and efficiently, reporting the results in a timely manner? " Oh it's rigged, no way they could have gone that fast ."
If precincts take their time counting the ballots and report everything at once? " Oh look how it all came in together, it's totally rigged ."
If the count takes a while, with precincts checking and reporting things all along the way? " Oh that took way too long, they were 'finding' more votes for themselves, that's completely rigged. "
These vote suppressors hold no logical position because they want you scared of voting and scared of our democracy. They think the only legitimate elections are the ones they win . And even then, opponents of voting rights will protest their own election race even if other races go the way they want for their party.
Team, these conspiracy theories have already been fired up even before a single vote has been cast. Chip in $25 or whatever you can to defend our democracy and our right to vote ahead of November's crucial election >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101024_3&amount=25]

These losers, liars, and conspiracy whackadoos don't understand how elections work. And they honestly don't care.
They are incapable of doing the simple math -- not just that 1 vote plus 1 vote equals 2 votes -- but that if every precinct is about the same size, each precinct will take about the same time to count, so of course the percentage of the vote counted and reported back will all come in around the same time.
Our elections are closely monitored. Electronic vote counting is backed up by human tabulation. Nonpartisan election workers monitor everything, and in many states, partisan activists are there to question and verify results as well.
None of that matters to these all-or-nothing, brainwashed sycophants who only want a demagogue to tell them who to blame for their problems and their anger and accept these lies without using an ounce of brainpower to question them. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Can I make a case for your support?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2042%2E135344%2EFw1TSp)

Friend --
In just 26 days, it will be Election Day.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate before that happens is one of the most strategic contributions you can make today.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign.
There is no winning the White House without Michigan. For Democrats, there is no holding the Senate without Michigan. Even our House delegation rests on a one-seat Democratic majority.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running -- in fact, it’s one of the few competitive races in the entire country. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.
Add the fact that this is going to be one of the most expensive races in the country -- not just with candidate spending, but outside spending too.
And I'll close with the news that in all of my elections, I have historically done better than Democrats usually do in the "redder" areas of the state. That means I am finding and pulling voters other races couldn't, and that is good for Kamala Harris and every other Democrat on the ballot on Election Day.
So yes, this race is kind of a unicorn. It's a unique situation where control of the White House and Congress is on the line, most voters don't know the candidates yet, and the Democratic Senate candidate can help the top of the ticket.
[**That's why I am asking for your support: Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate before our final FEC deadline ends in a few days? Team,

Every week, we’re seeing more and more horrifying stories of women bearing the consequences of Republican abortion bans. Women are having to travel out of state for an abortion or they’re being forced to wait until they’re in a**life-threatening situation** to receive care. **Patients dealing with lifelong health repercussions, or even dying, as a result of being denied care.**

Unfortunately, this is just the beginning.

Before I tell you more about what Project 2025 would mean for the fate of reproductive health care in Wisconsin and across the nation, I have to ask: [_**can you chip in to my campaign so I can flip this seat and pass federal protections that will ensure health care decisions are made by doctors and their patients, NOT anti-choice extremists with absolutely no medical background?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94770675/504508097/-735278981?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_2025_241010_T1_2&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_2025_241010_t1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzhlZmIyMS02Yzg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fs_IpiBofv57FoNaxba3ZqhQTQ-TlYn8lvrZQA1fU88=)

As an OB/GYN – a woman who takes care of women in this country – I can personally tell you that I am afraid of Project 2025. My patients are afraid.

What we see in this plan is pregnancy surveillance – Republicans want to track when people have their periods or a miscarriage. **That’s not normal.** Millions of women would lose access to emergency contraception. Project 2025 refuses to protect IVF and other fertility treatments. It would effectively ban abortion in all 50 states.

Politicians don’t need to be in my exam rooms, or any exam room for that matter.

Republicans trying to restrict our health care won’t stop. It’s as simple as that.

We need to flip Wisconsin’s 8th congressional district and take national action to safeguard reproductive rights. And we cannot wake up on November 6 and ask if there’s anything more we could have done.

[_**So, if you can, will you pitch in $5, $25, or more to my campaign? Every bit makes a difference as we work together to flip this district so I can lead the charge in Congress to protect reproductive rights >>>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94770676/504508125/-735278981?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_2025_241010_T1_2&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_2025_241010_t1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzhlZmIyMS02Yzg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fs_IpiBofv57FoNaxba3ZqhQTQ-TlYn8lvrZQA1fU88=)

Thank you for standing with me.

Before I tell you more about what Project 2025 would mean for the fate of reproductive health care in Wisconsin and across the nation, I have to ask: = As an OB/GYN – a woman who takes care of women in this country – I can personally tell you that I am afraid of Project 2025. My patients are afraid. What we see in this plan is pregnancy surveillance – Republicans want to track when people have their periods or a miscarriage. That’s not normal. Millions of women would lose access to emergency contraception. Project 2025 refuses to protect IVF and other fertility treatments. It would effectively ban abortion in all 50 states. Politicians don’t need to be in my exam rooms, or any exam room for that matter. Republicans trying to restrict our health care won’t stop. It’s as simple as that. We need to flip Wisconsin’s 8th congressional district and take national action to safeguard reproductive rights. And we cannot wake up on November 6 and ask if there’s anything more we could have done. = Thank you for standing with me. Hi fellow patriot,

I’m sure I’m not telling you anything you don’t know by now – that Ohio is the key to a Republican Senate majority.

You know if we win this race, then we win the Senate. You know only if we win the Senate will we be able to pass Pres. Trump’s agenda to restore economic stability, secure our border, and make America strong again.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2bcs20dd1bst6260skvv5g9h40m65vh9nve6jno_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm0o76c9h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2330bg11u0vq6cpade0k69ahavphkvtep6pt4ig_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm0o76c9h2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbhaugrn8vjgcjbef75qhajvf7c8hhb8lde1u46g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm0o76c9h2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zcqvrfdavu7h6uoo61gj8164pqkb2plu17qg9v5o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm0o71clh2bs)

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z1jqhmra2lucor6b33pg6c0bs43tjmocojk5n720_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm0o71clh2bs)_

| Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan _. _But [choosing the wrong one](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zjlt2p4h0lr2jistl9dkfl5up8kf8h86d3rhnva0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm4or1c9h2bs) could potentially wreak havoc on your retirement.

A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1

While advisors are prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people work with a financial advisor:
* Feel more at ease about their finances, and
* Could end up with 15% [more money to spend in retirement](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z42cca5tfg3803375spr9pr8e5t6u3pp7lqbmloo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm4or1c9h2bs).2

Answer a few questions to get matched with up to three vetted financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform have been rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and are legally bound to work in your best interest.

Ready to know what to look out for? Being aware of the 7 common mistakes people make when choosing a financial advisor can help you potentially save years of stress.

[See all 7 mistakes >>](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2unsok46d652qhjtrnuhkbs3kpno1ddkkqorfrg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm4or1c9h2bs)

# **Will A Trump Win Save Us?**
---
|
---
Now that Kamala Harris is the official nominee and getting the full honeymoon treatment from the Mainstream Media, many are questioning whether Trump can still win a second term as President. But what if Trump does win? Does it mean we’re out of the woods? Not necessarily. For starters, we’ve got $35 trillion in national debt and growing by the second. In fact, it cost us 76% of June’s total tax receipts just to pay the interest on that debt. On top of that, the Fed is set to cut rates twice this year, with their first move said to be in September - right before the election. This would likely lead to a short term jump in price of equities (potentially helping the Harris election bid), but it would also lend itself to a bullish scenario for gold and silver as it would be seen as an inflationary move.
---

---
| Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan _. _But [choosing the wrong one](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp2bcrlp9g0ischgto8hkhoomjcc4fsh5ddrnb38_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm6oj6c1h2bs) could potentially wreak havoc on your retirement.

A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1

While advisors are prohibited from promising returns, research suggests that people work with a financial advisor:
* Feel more at ease about their finances, and
* Could end up with 15% [more money to spend in retirement](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsr58pv7095g8ghui8cdkreosnsdkepc1o3sdpp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm6oj6c1h2bs).2

SmartAsset’s [no-cost tool](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvai2tguui47m67otvii3teqvjj3lfpmnou8go10_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0sdgm6oj6c1h2bs) simplifies the time consuming process of finding an advisor. Answer a few questions to get matched with up to three vetted financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform have been rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and are legally bound to work in your best interest.

Ready to know what to look out for? Being aware of the 7 common mistakes people make when choosing a financial advisor can help you potentially save years of stress.

subject: Can you think of a $44 billion joke?
body:
The Bee would know

| | | [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb4m4QLAZGH4p8vSnQ5eO6GIuCRLYFsZN8_aVqz5A1_NJR5_Ox83dMOU039-wkI25uro5JOf96cu1Z2qNqhNcqBPwE4CTXbAcTFCqIwu9GLTsBw3dw14uMkbyfpIBJjDRRElaD4AgeuEn1SV7eIAD8F5pZc4QvBqEITSD6tELpjhmqu0cK1FYCs4hJ0-1vSqtS23naSldto_W1o3Jf0yMTIwe_Ssvsyc6ZibGNeO8MTnurbhCIe2FySsVTJkJfcBt2etETF6RfsmEZcV0n5m8jv_fL5pr01Ub1mfKOW26Z4rfD8HPgfanSp9WfAcAAP__b-dvVQ)

|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb4m4QLAZGH4p8vSnQ5eO6GIuCRLYFsZN8_aVqz5A1_NJR5_Ox83dMOU039-wkI25uro5JOf96cu1Z2qNqhNcqBPwE4CTXbAcTFCqIwu9GLTsBw3dw14uMkbyfpIBJjDRRElaD4AgeuEn1SV7eIAD8F5pZc4QvBqEITSD6tELpjhmqu0cK1FYCs4hJ0-1vSqtS23naSldto_W1o3Jf0yMTIwe_Ssvsyc6ZibGNeO8MTnurbhCIe2FySsVTJkJfcBt2etETF6RfsmEZcV0n5m8jv_fL5pr01Ub1mfKOW26Z4rfD8HPgfanSp9WfAcAAP__b-dvVQ)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb4m4QLAZGH4p8vSnQ5eO6GIuCRLYFsZN8_aVqz5A1_NJR5_Ox83dMOU039-wkI25uro5JOf96cu1Z2qNqhNcqBPwE4CTXbAcTFCqIwu9GLTsBw3dw14uMkbyfpIBJjDRRElaD4AgeuEn1SV7eIAD8F5pZc4QvBqEITSD6tELpjhmqu0cK1FYCs4hJ0-1vSqtS23naSldto_W1o3Jf0yMTIwe_Ssvsyc6ZibGNeO8MTnurbhCIe2FySsVTJkJfcBt2etETF6RfsmEZcV0n5m8jv_fL5pr01Ub1mfKOW26Z4rfD8HPgfanSp9WfAcAAP__b-dvVQ)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb4m4QLAZGH4p8vSnQ5eO6GIuCRLYFsZN8_aVqz5A1_NJR5_Ox83dMOU039-wkI25uro5JOf96cu1Z2qNqhNcqBPwE4CTXbAcTFCqIwu9GLTsBw3dw14uMkbyfpIBJjDRRElaD4AgeuEn1SV7eIAD8F5pZc4QvBqEITSD6tELpjhmqu0cK1FYCs4hJ0-1vSqtS23naSldto_W1o3Jf0yMTIwe_Ssvsyc6ZibGNeO8MTnurbhCIe2FySsVTJkJfcBt2etETF6RfsmEZcV0n5m8jv_fL5pr01Ub1mfKOW26Z4rfD8HPgfanSp9WfAcAAP__b-dvVQ)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb4m4QLAZGH4p8vSnQ5eO6GIuCRLYFsZN8_aVqz5A1_NJR5_Ox83dMOU039-wkI25uro5JOf96cu1Z2qNqhNcqBPwE4CTXbAcTFCqIwu9GLTsBw3dw14uMkbyfpIBJjDRRElaD4AgeuEn1SV7eIAD8F5pZc4QvBqEITSD6tELpjhmqu0cK1FYCs4hJ0-1vSqtS23naSldto_W1o3Jf0yMTIwe_Ssvsyc6ZibGNeO8MTnurbhCIe2FySsVTJkJfcBt2etETF6RfsmEZcV0n5m8jv_fL5pr01Ub1mfKOW26Z4rfD8HPgfanSp9WfAcAAP__b-dvVQ)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkLFu8yAURp8Gb4m4QLAZGH4p8vSnQ5eO6GIuCRLYFsZN8_aVqz5A1_NJR5_Ox83dMOU039-wkI25uro5JOf96cu1Z2qNqhNcqBPwE4CTXbAcTFCqIwu9GLTsBw3dw14uMkbyfpIBJjDRRElaD4AgeuEn1SV7eIAD8F5pZc4QvBqEITSD6tELpjhmqu0cK1FYCs4hJ0-1vSqtS23naSldto_W1o3Jf0yMTIwe_Ssvsyc6ZibGNeO8MTnurbhCIe2FySsVTJkJfcBt2etETF6RfsmEZcV0n5m8jv_fL5pr01Ub1mfKOW26Z4rfD8HPgfanSp9WfAcAAP__b-dvVQ)** Thanks for considering standing with us. | | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AuuQQHS2NbUAe7Hh5nThCA~~/AARclAA~/RgRo63gGP0RlaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8zZDdhZWYzOC00YTM3LTRlNjUtYTRjOC00Nzc0NDkzYjFkNzU_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONTYwNzdXA3NwY0IKZwUG3whnaSUKjVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AuuQQHS2NbUAe7Hh5nThCA~~/AARclAA~/RgRo63gGP0RlaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8zZDdhZWYzOC00YTM3LTRlNjUtYTRjOC00Nzc0NDkzYjFkNzU_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONTYwNzdXA3NwY0IKZwUG3whnaSUKjVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)_

[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AuuQQHS2NbUAe7Hh5nThCA~~/AARclAA~/RgRo63gGP0RlaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8zZDdhZWYzOC00YTM3LTRlNjUtYTRjOC00Nzc0NDkzYjFkNzU_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONTYwNzdXA3NwY0IKZwUG3whnaSUKjVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---
Friend, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AuuQQHS2NbUAe7Hh5nThCA~~/AARclAA~/RgRo63gGP0RlaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8zZDdhZWYzOC00YTM3LTRlNjUtYTRjOC00Nzc0NDkzYjFkNzU_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONTYwNzdXA3NwY0IKZwUG3whnaSUKjVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**_

subject: Can you think of a $44 billion joke?
body:
free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one)

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d763848d5154f73a9dbaabbd8dfb94a&_e=OmLI8oyLszlYPB-YKP-4zdCgy3k4X-DNDaoPsN591xr9zjE5OHGG3-9An4yqsG6Wr_RJM8Z-ci_bGE-Mv40qfo9EzQAsB-BaWSn47Suyq9yRNMjHcnR4bRvYYoq3CwVQJQrxxsl8eI6f3lguPSJ7Qhl_cQGHA9vWw6zTSiogmK1arvumNventV3Yzk3rsohiCaTki-qF53M8xWwaABBNPCzdcV8MHb33BNXU02LWS_zisyDPwB8ls_znU7lJBKJfYlYWJ2GJdnbo7nuaVus1kQ%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d763848d5154f73a9dbaabbd8dfb94a&_e=OmLI8oyLszlYPB-YKP-4zdCgy3k4X-DNDaoPsN591xr9zjE5OHGG3-9An4yqsG6Wr_RJM8Z-ci_bGE-Mv40qfo9EzQAsB-BaWSn47Suyq9yRNMjHcnR4bRvYYoq3CwVQoQSRyk81D0CvEpcNQBk65D-PrqqgSa9102TKA_f9bJHTXtsG1PQo64fAOg8C35XYL9L7ZkMdfF2HRNbude_LgSAA_PmuXo6NFojnWYv-YRsERyZbDjG-3jtxEMiPNWG9efwfE3Kj2u36neaLSYBLcQ%3D%3D)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d763848d5154f73a9dbaabbd8dfb94a&_e=OmLI8oyLszlYPB-YKP-4zdCgy3k4X-DNDaoPsN591xr9zjE5OHGG3-9An4yqsG6Wr_RJM8Z-ci_bGE-Mv40qfo9EzQAsB-BaWSn47Suyq9yRNMjHcnR4bRvYYoq3CwVQuOEfrDbmJM1XHf1VdXTNFQ9WotDWBA3LVH-4OJP18Nhsfcqh738piIowDCkceej1IzH3TVttSmsgtC18aWeRVqmLpwOZd6sziZ0DLr96NAcje5EYdPXGl77l9iQX6eo02QEbx0hS827wRz-FE2Mfbg%3D%3D)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d763848d5154f73a9dbaabbd8dfb94a&_e=OmLI8oyLszlYPB-YKP-4zdCgy3k4X-DNDaoPsN591xr9zjE5OHGG3-9An4yqsG6Wr_RJM8Z-ci_bGE-Mv40qfo9EzQAsB-BaWSn47Suyq9yRNMjHcnR4bRvYYoq3CwVQuf-pHJp0DE_cYZFRTTHmO1w3zMk8Vc1XbsgqjblYh6KW3WrROyRE5y0ZBqusntBmGL4wUxj8VZA0INIXuintZv2GR9AQ74fjMF0UTqXzc8synaGuEZ4q-8WBu7i8jiYvBlatDBrNyUHfIZwIL7r3Sg%3D%3D)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d763848d5154f73a9dbaabbd8dfb94a&_e=OmLI8oyLszlYPB-YKP-4zdCgy3k4X-DNDaoPsN591xr9zjE5OHGG3-9An4yqsG6Wr_RJM8Z-ci_bGE-Mv40qfo9EzQAsB-BaWSn47Suyq9yRNMjHcnR4bRvYYoq3CwVQihMvQfDHEYHxxozaIpv1zmsLn-sbo__7P5r8MObGJunur7QuMeXnwaT4v7JPPM_ltAsmwntVk8W-SndkAmiwJUifsK9V9U2yxfg5ZC-ExeT60KY4NVaNp2A6f2Q6TYHCJmW0W6qpi2EQGJdOOku-Ww%3D%3D)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d763848d5154f73a9dbaabbd8dfb94a&_e=OmLI8oyLszlYPB-YKP-4zdCgy3k4X-DNDaoPsN591xr9zjE5OHGG3-9An4yqsG6Wr_RJM8Z-ci_bGE-Mv40qfo9EzQAsB-BaWSn47Suyq9yRNMjHcnR4bRvYYoq3CwVQjOgfA264yJ0RpDLh5JJx3GpcZm3Ke5Rrmiv5KP1s2JBIx60zKhykBDKYKcITiBXBsn1V6CbO0HV7rcQWruAdB3W6RI4gbf5zlpJZ5am65MHOo51z_ABlps3KLNoOWk6tmJUmnL-Vk99OuVmBqD1AdQ%3D%3D)** Thanks for considering standing with us. We'll stand with you, too.

# **Will A Trump Win Save Us?**
---
|
---
Now that Kamala Harris is the official nominee and getting the full honeymoon treatment from the Mainstream Media, many are questioning whether Trump can still win a second term as President. But what if Trump does win? Does it mean we’re out of the woods? Not necessarily. For starters, we’ve got $35 trillion in national debt and growing by the second. In fact, it cost us 76% of June’s total tax receipts just to pay the interest on that debt. On top of that, the Fed is set to cut rates twice this year, with their first move said to be in September - right before the election. This would likely lead to a short term jump in price of equities (potentially helping the Harris election bid), but it would also lend itself to a bullish scenario for gold and silver as it would be seen as an inflationary move.
---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Yy1PWciX2Wmld8eFSVacvg~~/AARclAA~/RgRo638iP0TyaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucHJvdGVjdGluZ215c2F2aW5ncy1lbWFpbC5jb20vdHJ1bXAtZ29sZC13cC1ibHVlLTA4MDgyNC8_c2ZjaWQ9NzAxUWgwMDAwMEplUGVKJnV0bV90ZXJtPVJNLU9HVC0yMDI0MTAxMSZscz0wMDEtRW1haWwtUG9wYWN0YSZjbj04NTUtNzE3LTAyMjEmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1Qb3BhY3RhJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTcwMVFoMDAwMDBKZVBlSiZ1dG1fdGVybT1STS1PR1QtMjAyNDEwMTFXA3NwY0IKZwW86Qhnp5RGS1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---

body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkMGOmzAQhp_G3EDjsQPxgUMkll6y2ao99Igce0wsGYNss9W-fUWb3Hudf_TP982v9-ld--DjfNML9S6kKeUp6unhQ6hNKnVY4zwhoKw51JxPorI9cGWlrKjnHZ5beYJWVI9eWduiFg6UMcZwaJ3iAqFz0EpFylW-P3o4cA5KnqFt7ni68w4doVNa2TOToAOl0rhEZNdFRxv8nVL5SrStqTRmXarQP0rZMhMXhiPD0Ue3NgdutjpQQ3ZnOB7keU-f9HUsiTEbJgbgpw5vgBKvcBk-hre3nwzbvSxTXvdkiIlhS2veyBQf52e0kPX7wsRAi_bhOTR62bSfIxODSeV16F-0xkKxMDFcP27fpu-Xerz-qF_iVert9tuH4HPbMQnzUfpXq_zf8z97_BMAAP__UpyKyg)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkMGOmzAQhp_G3EDjsQPxgUMkll6y2ao99Igce0wsGYNss9W-fUWb3Hudf_TP982v9-ld--DjfNML9S6kKeUp6unhQ6hNKnVY4zwhoKw51JxPorI9cGWlrKjnHZ5beYJWVI9eWduiFg6UMcZwaJ3iAqFz0EpFylW-P3o4cA5KnqFt7ni68w4doVNa2TOToAOl0rhEZNdFRxv8nVL5SrStqTRmXarQP0rZMhMXhiPD0Ue3NgdutjpQQ3ZnOB7keU-f9HUsiTEbJgbgpw5vgBKvcBk-hre3nwzbvSxTXvdkiIlhS2veyBQf52e0kPX7wsRAi_bhOTR62bSfIxODSeV16F-0xkKxMDFcP27fpu-Xerz-qF_iVert9tuH4HPbMQnzUfpXq_zf8z97_BMAAP__UpyKyg)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkMGOmzAQhp_G3EDjsQPxgUMkll6y2ao99Igce0wsGYNss9W-fUWb3Hudf_TP982v9-ld--DjfNML9S6kKeUp6unhQ6hNKnVY4zwhoKw51JxPorI9cGWlrKjnHZ5beYJWVI9eWduiFg6UMcZwaJ3iAqFz0EpFylW-P3o4cA5KnqFt7ni68w4doVNa2TOToAOl0rhEZNdFRxv8nVL5SrStqTRmXarQP0rZMhMXhiPD0Ue3NgdutjpQQ3ZnOB7keU-f9HUsiTEbJgbgpw5vgBKvcBk-hre3nwzbvSxTXvdkiIlhS2veyBQf52e0kPX7wsRAi_bhOTR62bSfIxODSeV16F-0xkKxMDFcP27fpu-Xerz-qF_iVert9tuH4HPbMQnzUfpXq_zf8z97_BMAAP__UpyKyg)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkMGOmzAQhp_G3EDjsQPxgUMkll6y2ao99Igce0wsGYNss9W-fUWb3Hudf_TP982v9-ld--DjfNML9S6kKeUp6unhQ6hNKnVY4zwhoKw51JxPorI9cGWlrKjnHZ5beYJWVI9eWduiFg6UMcZwaJ3iAqFz0EpFylW-P3o4cA5KnqFt7ni68w4doVNa2TOToAOl0rhEZNdFRxv8nVL5SrStqTRmXarQP0rZMhMXhiPD0Ue3NgdutjpQQ3ZnOB7keU-f9HUsiTEbJgbgpw5vgBKvcBk-hre3nwzbvSxTXvdkiIlhS2veyBQf52e0kPX7wsRAi_bhOTR62bSfIxODSeV16F-0xkKxMDFcP27fpu-Xerz-qF_iVert9tuH4HPbMQnzUfpXq_zf8z97_BMAAP__UpyKyg)

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

## Milton Wreaks Havoc: Deaths and Rescues
Hurricane Milton, which made [landfall on Florida's west coast](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLEOnDAQRL_GdEbexYajcJGG7tKmRHt4ORwZfDIL6P4-IlLKNDPNaGb0fj3HJ8UUt_dPWtnLnEeaJJ48gtEAGu1oq-BnZuSmYg8dPlrbOmiqxVvounaCHp0zoeuxtc1rdi1aCw9ng62iR4MWDAAY0wPUbm6tZe6DoTA19FLWcIiSS_07x00WntM3n1zqKa9V8ovIZ1fND4WDwuG6rvrYSXKg7x1QOOySy1fhsPG130YS86ZwuGcVDmD-yXKUEifaWK8xSd50iifr4xNIeNdzyiUG0jQLl5Vk0bIcZQ90d3fO9T02vTGdwqEqPnyumFLc205Z814ppr935T_0To9_AgAA__8vVm-U) as a Category 3 storm on Wednesday, has caused at least 11 fatalities and forced millions to evacuate.The storm unleashed tornadoes, powerful winds, and flooding, leaving widespread destruction. In [Hillsborough County](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FugzAQgOGnMZujO2NMGDx0YUvXjuhiH-Fag5FxiPr2Vbt3_odf38dtupEk2R7vtLKvc54oVDl5QtCI2tjJNtHPzIbbhj325uqs67BtFj8ADvfQO-77KwJ00UaIzt2d5UgdtI14A8YiICLAgHjpZmct8xCBYmjprixwlJrL5TPLVhee03c-uVxCXpvkl1r3Q7VvyozKjLRv_Dp-kzJjkpOVGZdnKRJoY71KqnnTc8pFIulaKHxx0c89UuWjKT7uL0lJDtcrC4-VJP1d6j_o05ufAAAA___dNFrH), more than 725 people and 128 pets were rescued from flood-prone areas after an unprecedented 356 emergency calls.Environmental concerns have also risen over the potential release of hazardous waste from over 1 billion tons of [radioactive phosphogypsum](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFv8yAUAH-NvRHBA2MYGL4lW761o4XhEb8Kg0WIo_bXV-ne8XTL6T5uy81TpnL_73d0PdXFh04nLoIzIRioRY3RJURAOaITMxit9CTkuDnhDawotYo8aJitsas2ZpWIFnTi80gOOCjBhRCcWyEuU9JKIdrIfQzSr4PiGKnXdvmsVPqGKX_VE9sl1H3Mbuv9eAzy3wDXAa7-KPh6vNUbWqeQcYDr9myNgi_Idsq9FpZybRQ9w3JSq2XH0lnC1inTNzZ21JyfnWphNnAjpQkJoo5KTBJswMmq1RthQsSxuXi8KGd66HlQ_L57yr9p_Y9Tp4OfAAAA___M7mww) stored at fertilizer sites like Piney Point.Additionally, the storm ripped the roof off Tropicana Field, where National Guard members and linemen had been staged for recovery efforts. [Here is a photo](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOpCAUhZ8GOwxcGB0Lim3sZtstzRWu492gGGDG-PYbt_-7k3OSky_fn9f0Qo68v3_jRq4uaUJf-UuTVlJrCXayTXALEZBpyOkenp3tHto0q_M0G7SmB-uhD_45-FmbJwBiF_xj6Bp2oMBqpbVWatC6fSydtURDUBi8wVlYRYFryu3fxHtdaYlX-lJufdqa6NZajyLMLwGjgPE8z9bPZaez3LuA8Y4CxvWTM3vcSW4ca9plzem4C5QLUwwyp7TIQKXmdFGQFbcD5YyXzHgVWSoG_tx_TXbhODlGLl0vrHpvyPE_S_1BzdfBvwAAAP__ZxBpag).

---
Friend -- My campaign slogan "Nuclear Power Not Nuclear War" reflects the call for a new paradigm of peace which must be fueled by unlimited energy production. Join us for this Friday night's New York Symposium to discuss the emerging reality of new nuclear power development throughout the world. I will be joined in this discussion by the Director of _Nuclear New York_ , which organization recently sponsored a very important conference entitled "Nuclear Symposium 2024: Uplifting Humanity.".The conference presented important work in nuclear fuel reprocessing, uranium mining, the creation of advanced energy grids in developing countries, and questions of ending poverty through nuclear energy production. Speakers at the conference included an international group of young engineers from the Caribbean, Ghana, Taiwan, France, and the US -- a number of whom a mere few years earlier had defined themselves as "anti-nuclear." I will also be joined by another participant in that conference who represents the activity of the "yak tityu tityu yak tiłhini" Indian tribe, which tribe played a critical role in saving the Diablo Canyon plant. Their activity contrasted the scam of wind and solar so-called renewables, with the energy flux density available through the peaceful use of nuclear energy. My campaign is committed to consigning those who engulf the world in permanent war into their appropriate circles of hell. Can we create a world without war, in which science is used for peace and the development of all? We are going to need a lot of energy! Join the discussion this Friday night!
### [New York Symposium, October 11 , 2024, 8:00 PM ](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=2PNlHEbVYFsh-F_FzIY8ncSRRzVSu0q5bq9Xq9CCZSw&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241011_symposium&n=2)

If you've ever gotten in trouble for something that wasn't your fault, [this North Texas man](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO2zAQBNCvobo1yBUpSwWLNOoubUpjTS6tRWjRIHnS5e-Dc-rUgxngza-P2wdJlv3xk57s-1cqNwpdDr4ZDcYA2psdor_ruJiBvbniPNl5sThsPmJaUjJBcyRLQd_1zJajMTqZ0TkcxKNGa7QxRrtZL5dEE5oQ7mNwNo3uqqzmKL3US9-48xe1lP-Ug-sllOeQ_db7q6nxh8JV4Xqe5-X3Vj6_Q4Ur1S4hs8J157MpXHMJlBWu7yGIVQ6uUDmwHNwgSKcuZYdUKmQJvDeGV6bODeJnlf0BnVv_1wPqEJky17bJS-GK8xV4cozRRUjLfQbrwgQLXycgjsbNmi0t41B9fJ2Ss7Tpm_d4kuS3pv_v3cPj3wAAAP__viZ9yQ) who was cited for missing a license plate while taking a test drive would like to swap stories with you! ## Over Half of Texas Counties Under Burn Ban
Over half of the state's 254 counties are under a burn ban, according to the [Texas A&M Forest Service](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L-OozAQgPGnMV2QZ2xsKFzcKaLL6botkf-Mw2hNQGCR7Nuvsv12X_nT93Gbbp4LP-7__EKuvvI6-Vj5pAnkBeCCetJNckGmARpyYLE3uh80NrNTKnc2IYZkkEIImDylHhWZoeu7CA07lKhBAoDsejm02RuEGIOKnc6qs0JLSlzXva0zVXr5I5ev9aS9jevSFDfXuh1C_RE4ChxrPu58tIvfjtbv8d1xXQSOftsOgeOTgt-2k-lJu8CRH4le7VyXItTISagr9T7ZqDNYGzRJO9ikItg4mKwheyPQLGvgQn938p__V35Uoa4gZbO7tD25FD7MG31fPJcfY_3t2enwOwAA__-7rm2Y). Central Texas hasn't seen [any measurable rain since early September](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGuozAQheGngc7IMxgDhYtt6LLtlmhsZoK1DkTGgezbr5L-1r909On8uc03iilu99_0YFfess8USjx5Bq0AFJrZ1IvzehmhZgc9DtYMo8F6ddQOXrgDtBa0CBhZSCy1GFDsKG0dHWo0oAFAd4MeGyGLEIJvQ2ek7frKaF5i2XNTVi78pkPSv_3k3IT9USe3lvI8qvZXhVOF03Vdzd_zxZ9Y4US5xJD4E5jKyrnCKfBWMiX13VL-lTflaTsqnNCOCrVo7I1RjP2ozBJAea-9IhuMSNcNI_d1dsvziinFw3589wfF9OWUn-45Hf4PAAD__4mOZYo), and every county between San Antonio and Waco has issued burn bans within the past three months. Drought conditions in much of Southeast Texas worsened in the past week, prompting several counties to [join the list of those with burn bans](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LtuwyAUgOGnwduJOBjfBoYu3tK1o8XlECMRsIBc_PZVunf-l0__z3W76hBDun3rO6n29nnTtoUnbcgBEYTcZOeU4W7BjhROYh7lvEjR7cqNdsRhIecFLTRJrhfynOM8Gc_NNHdBCS4kckTkw8yXi9ejQGtNbwfp-2FikpMLLZdL26nRW1cfz_ykcrH53kW1t3ZU1n8xsTKxamOx_xQm1iPXxsS661JCBZ9LA0PJwUvHSAViMFTaCTY_UgtUwTxKAqMTFKpHTpXgKDnmdCMHrpyw5wYv0m2nAtn7YIOOFao-mVhxkHzBeWBi7YpyxyvEGOr40d_uOsQ_bPtv3lOJ3wAAAP__9dtz6w). According to the [U.S. Drought Monitor](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z71urDAQxfGnsbtFnsF8uHBxG7q9VaSkQ8YeFksGIzNsyNtH2TJS-nP00__9Pt5dTHF7_HcrWb7mPDrP8UkjqBvADfWoZbCTCgYkWeiwb3VvNMrF-tkToZnaqaG2M50HbQJ2Bgh0r0nJaFGhBgUAqumVqWbXIng_1b7Rc910QisKkXOpeCGmyx1z-spPKpXPq0x2Yd4PUf8TOAgcQsnnY-E1b6_LuaWKwilw8GcptPHqdoHDwY7p19Qd-yXq4e1DFhv2z5hSPNof_bG6mF4Y_xX_tPgdAAD__7F-Xss), a drought is affecting nearly 83% of Texas, up from 45% in July.
## School District Cracks Down on Unpaid Lunch Debt
Keller ISD is implementing a new policy of [providing "alternative school meals"](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGStCAQBOCn0QwLRnQ1IPgTs_3TC60BhpU6lC2YW_fe_srLL-ugg6_7477eMaZ4PP7jTobfIa_oOL5oVVIoJUCvuvXGSj-rloy6wTTqadbQbkZa57yeJ_QBabBWutHJUWnAGWcY-zYakKCVVErJYZJzF3AE5Zzt3aBDP9waLclHzqXjjZjeWEP6zi8qnct7m8zG_KxN_6-BpYHlPM8u5Lc-6KxXoYHlig0sn5QSFRGrFzkEKgITUznwGiKq23JOYidMVVT-8nRwFXsuJHjDQ8AgPFlui_HPM6YU63jBHjvG9Ovgv355GfgJAAD__3LmaFU) to students whose lunch account balance exceeds $25 after racking up $66,000 in debt on unpaid lunches last year. The alternative meals include a [SunButter and jelly sandwich](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOozAQxvGngW4iZjCJKSiuodtrr4zG42GxzoGVPQmbtz9x_daf9Em__5-P-wennLbP3_zQyb6X_c5i6aV37AARyN1dG6fQxRFbnfBG_ur86KhdJ3V-HANiDNLx0LP36ghvYxwkcsChTRN15LBDxG7w3XhZ-EooEnoZ3NIPt8Z1GpPt5WKrmn5zXfJ7f2m5yP5o87SafdWm_9XQ3NB8HMflWJjPsaGZiyXJ2tC86VEbmjU-hS3tW0PzX81ZC6Qaodoz6mYVjmQr5OcmK0QNBrZDUKhaXhqBs2nZ-KTDQzlXiKlaSWJQ-X3ek78BS-idHwXGRXpw5COwoAJHR0KoeGVpyxS_jpRzqtdT-PnglP-D7KfAr4n-BQAA___uEH74) for breakfast and a turkey and cheese sandwich for lunch. Students are also given fresh fruit and either white or chocolate milk. SunButter is a sunflower seed-based substitute for peanut butter. While some community members believe the policy could [stigmatize students with limited resources](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFyhCAQgOGn0Q6HXRG1oEhjd2lTOgjLyYSTG9k7Lm-fSSZt-r_45v-4rBcbUzyu7_ZGhl8hr9ZxfNIKUgAIVKtqvdmkn6ElAyNOWk2zwnY346TGgL1XWx8Ipk0rtFIrq0etYQJoo0GJCiQAyGGScxesRnBu692gQj-MjZLkI-ez452YXraE9JWfdHYu39pkduZ7afq3BpcGl1pr521KtuSt0PmXNbgcVEuDyyelRKeIxYvCD08HF1Ej7yI9DrcLTxsLziKHQCd5sdkSnSj28DW6nYpAOc6gBtmext9rTCkW_UO83mxMvyL-79DT4HcAAAD__1_4afw), the district is encouraging families who are struggling financially to apply for free or reduced lunches. The policy goes into effect Oct. 21.
## Smashed Guitar Sold Again on eBay
A Taylor Swift guitar smashed with a hammer in a viral video [sold on eBay this week](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGP4yAQhX8N7iaCMTh2QXGNu732ymg8DAkSCRGQePPvT95-uyc96X363r-vyxelnB7Xv3QX379juRD39JaL0WAMoL3YIfhNh8UM4s0Z58nOi8Xh5s_O6ZkMBUanrXBAdhqNnpGnSFsYkkeN1mhjjHazXk6RJjTM28jOxtGdldUSUi_11G_S5ZtazJ_ylnrich-yv_X-bGr8o3BVuO77ftoj0VEqXKn2xFkUrg_Zm8I1F6ascO30yaVC21PscH2lThXandpNAtCrl2ul55El59SAy-vRP_BDB9noA_TinsoDGmWBZ018MHA-w8ijjdpssCzOgDVaYJu0AEUSiyPzPPJQfXju6ZieDr_rnVL-0em_3fv2-D8AAP__rA59rw) for $6,550, over $2,500 more than it was purchased for during a charity auction in Waxahachie last month. It received 46 bids. ## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=08cfd9c298504db884fc675c5f436c44&_e=26wWLHPHPtgVs_n97Z3wFnqIJc9C2V-OPTGnSw5ztfK0UjJoBRZeYX6y4_O3Lr-HPrbkTatXEPsQhoPAP05yCp-ab526L6eNzUxDCOuuUnKCP9522EKRjFcQX_WRiIcc4ZQ1ynhcnBjuhRy6ADcykhyPcTzU5ZNlilhgW22BZvrGnyJSCBZJrPZenHRGwzK3NGpRXYNWcXDmR27uIqQGukjLnwmw8pD7yCMrb9cRuVCdjGf9sNsO_Cm3Jks1Z-OD4WnNKulcS-Frjf-25jJc5R0VPFlQ8uewDjFJODHz_rX2ezQYN96KTYzx5RLu5TSxDNTv5fP6iMjGh0XOmsFHxHe9aqmB_FfgbM5a_DeHOXE3UIni0gViJPCOqrKQL0vrvxrvhRNukgnZMkOv7Y29hITg8yjkr_wAOSjTBNfWY5c%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=08cfd9c298504db884fc675c5f436c44&_e=26wWLHPHPtgVs_n97Z3wFnqIJc9C2V-OPTGnSw5ztfK0UjJoBRZeYX6y4_O3Lr-HPrbkTatXEPsQhoPAP05yCp-ab526L6eNzUxDCOuuUnKCP9522EKRjFcQX_WRiIcc4ZQ1ynhcnBjuhRy6ADcykhyPcTzU5ZNlilhgW22BZvrGnyJSCBZJrPZenHRGwzK3NGpRXYNWcXDmR27uIqQGukjLnwmw8pD7yCMrb9cRuVCdjGf9sNsO_Cm3Jks1Z-OD4WnNKulcS-Frjf-25jJc5RXeDvCWQIx9nXCEejztDw0eSs-nbWV3oVwo6OEv4LH7KcOm397WUCMv-vfR1MiQ-v__fN6EyRMGPtaY1-ehmrGqHhjAMyj8LmEbCHsZ96_PV0lUq5lJsz5l3aTLQVeMahbswfOKTvGC_oPYXHSuvJA%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. **Here is just a sampling of the proposals in this extreme MAGA plan:**
* **Project 2025 would stop federal work protecting our elections from foreign threats.** Project 2025 recommends dismantling the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Agency, which is devoted to securing elections from interference. The agency is currently housed in the Department of Homeland Security, and its minimized work functions would be moved under the Department of Transportation. Yep, you read that right.
* **Project 2025 would install political actors to decide who does and doesn’t get counted in the census** instead of nonpartisan actors. The plan also calls for a citizenship question on the census, which could undercount the population in areas with high rates of immigrants and unfairly shift power away from minority communities.
* **Project 2025 would weaken the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division,** which is responsible for defending Americans of color in civil rights cases like violations of the Voting Rights Act (VRA).

**This last point hits me hard. I dedicate my career to upholding the VRA.** In fact, my most recent favorite memory is reading the U.S Supreme Court’s decision in _Allen v. Milligan_ , which helped remedy discriminatory redistricting in Alabama. I felt so proud to see the highest court in our land say that people of color deserve federal legal protections of their right to vote. **But Project 2025 wants to upend the federal team that protects minority voters’ rights. **
Here’s the thing, Peter: I absolutely believe that together we will level the playing field and ensure that power rests with every American voter — not with extremist politicians. And I believe that in this election we can decisively show MAGA Republicans that we will not sit by and watch them rip up the fabric of our democracy.
And here’s the best part: Since state-level elections can be won by a _few hundred_ votes, every dollar given today goes further to put the right people in the right places.

Just take a look at Google searches from the last three months: | = Project 2025 isn’t trending, but it should be. It is still very much a threat, whether or not Trump is elected president. The truth is, Republicans are already working state-by-state to push forward these dangerous and unpopular ideas. We’re fighting furiously to elect Democracy Defenders across the country who will stand up to this far-right plan to strip our rights and destroy our democracy. And since state-level races are often won by the slimmest of margins, a gift right now could go a long way for these down-ballot candidates. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Here is just a sampling of the proposals in this extreme MAGA plan: Project 2025 would stop federal work protecting our elections from foreign threats. Project 2025 recommends dismantling the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Agency, which is devoted to securing elections from interference. The agency is currently housed in the Department of Homeland Security, and its minimized work functions would be moved under the Department of Transportation. Yep, you read that right. Project 2025 would install political actors to decide who does and doesn’t get counted in the census instead of nonpartisan actors. The plan also calls for a citizenship question on the census, which could undercount the population in areas with high rates of immigrants and unfairly shift power away from minority communities. Project 2025 would weaken the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, which is responsible for defending Americans of color in civil rights cases like violations of the Voting Rights Act (VRA). This last point hits me hard. I dedicate my career to upholding the VRA. In fact, my most recent favorite memory is reading the U.S Supreme Court’s decision in Allen v. Milligan , which helped remedy discriminatory redistricting in Alabama. I felt so proud to see the highest court in our land say that people of color deserve federal legal protections of their right to vote. But Project 2025 wants to upend the federal team that protects minority voters’ rights. Here’s the thing, Peter: I absolutely believe that together we will level the playing field and ensure that power rests with every American voter — not with extremist politicians. And I believe that in this election we can decisively show MAGA Republicans that we will not sit by and watch them rip up the fabric of our democracy. body:
| | | | READY DAY ONE
---
---
|
# PROVEN, TESTED, EXPERIENCED CONSERVATIVE LEADERSHIP
# YOU CAN TRUST
---
| Friends, While there are a number of candidates seeking the Republican nomination for State Senate in Senate District 10 to finish John McGuire's state senate term, I'm the only candidate who has already served in the Virginia Senate as a state senator and able to successfully serve on day one.
I served as a Virginia state senator for 8 years from 2016 to 2023. I already know the rules of the senate. While other candidates may have other experience, it will take them years to learn how to successfully and efficiently navigate reading and digesting over 3,000 bills in less than 45 days, all while balancing committee meeting assignments and floor votes.
Remember. The Republican mass meeting will most likely take place in December of this year, the Special Election will take place on Tuesday, January 7, the day before the General Assembly gavels in for the 2025 Legislative session.
There will be no learning curve needed for me. I will be able to hit the ground running on day one.
Because this isn't my first year in the Virginia Senate, I will also go in with seniority that no other candidate is able to bring to the table, increasing my chances of becoming a committee chair or leader in the Virginia Senate.
When the nominee for Senate District 10 is sworn in, session will have already started, and deadlines will have already passed for prefiling bills. Unless you are an experienced senator, who already has legislation submitted in prior years and ready to go, they will be a lame duck senator with no bills to present. That's why you need my experience.
In addition to my experience and knowledge in working in the Virginia Senate, I have a conservative voting record you can trust all 8 years I served in the Virginia Senate:
100% Pro-family, The Family Foundations scorecard, 2016-2023
100% Pro-gun, VCDL Virginia Citizen's Defense League, 2016-2023
A rating, NRA, 2016-2023
100% Pro-small business, National Federation of Independent Business, 2016-2023.
You have the opportunity to support an award winning effective conservative senator with 8 years of experience as a senator and a 100 percent conservative voting record you can trust who knows how to win.
Today, I ask for your vote if you live in Amelia, Appomattox, Buckingham, Cumberland, Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa, Prince Edward, Henrico, Hanover and Powhatan in the upcoming Special Election.
If you live outside the district, I ask for your most generous donation. You may not be able to vote for me, but I can certainly vote for you.
---
|
---
Virginia Senate, 2016-2023, 8 years of experience as Senator 8 year, conservative voting record
---
---
The Virginia Chamber of Commerce, A Voting Record, Distinguished Advocate for Virginia Business
---
---
The American Conservative Union, Conservative Excellence 2016-2023
---
---
Legislator of the Year Award, Treasurer's Association of Virginia
---
|
# MY FAITH IN JESUS
---
|
# WHY I STAND
---
| My faith in God through Jesus is central to who I am. It doesn't mean I'm perfect, but through all of the trials, persecution and struggles, it's my faith that I turn to and from which I draw strength during the good times and the more challenging times.
I accepted Jesus into my heart when I was in the 2nd grade. As a young teen and young adult my relationship with the Lord became more personal. I felt compelled to go on several missions trips and while in college at Virginia Tech was very involved with Campus Crusade for Christ, which is now called Cru.
It was during my college years that I began to study the Bible and my faith strengthened. I remember spending my spring break in Daytona sharing the gospel of Christ with people on the beach.
As a young adult who worked full time in management in the finance and banking field, I spent some week nights and weekends visiting people who had visited our church and led several small group Bible studies.
As a young mother, I left corporate America to raise and homeschool our 4 children under a religious exemption statue. It was then I began to volunteer for the Family Foundation and led various programs and coops for homeschool families seeking opportunities for their children. It was also then that I began to volunteer for various political campaigns for conservative Republicans.
One thing lead to another and my volunteerism lead to serving as campaign staff, political director and even campaign manager for various federal, state and local elected officials.
Ultimately, I would run and win a state senate seat, overcoming a 28 year incumbent. I served in the Virginia Senate for 8 years from 2016 to 2023, until I was "defeated" by 375 mail-in and early votes out of 22,000 votes, in which my campaign was denied overseeing of the early voting machines.
I contested the race, but was ultimately ignored by the Virginia State Board of Elections and the Republican Party of Virginia. We sought justice legally, but we were ignored. The people of Senate District 12 were disenfranchised but no one had the boldness to investigate our concern, despite our best efforts to fight the injustice. It was a frustrating experience but at the end of the day I trusted the Lord to ultimately bring justice.
Many of you have heard me say the Holy Spirit is my GPS. That is true.
Like many of you, I too get distracted and take the longer route because I wasn't paying attention. However, my heart is to put God first every morning, listen to His voice and follow the path that He has laid before me through doors that I believe He opens and closes. While I believe my loss was nefarious at best, it was a door God closed. And one I had a hard time accepting because of the appearance of cheating.
I've had former employees who had worked for me in the past and been good to literally stab me in the back. They accepted money from other elected officials who I had challenged on various policies to betray and defame my good character and reputation. They came after me politically, professionally and personally. A Richmond General District Court judge granted me a protective order against one employee who continues to follow me to this day.
Why? Because I wasn't popular with the other politicians. I wouldn't just go along to get along. I took a stand.
Life begins at conception, not 15 weeks, for starters. I refused to approve a Health and Human Resources Cabinet member because they refused to reverse Governor Northam's position regarding healthcare providers ability to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid.
I refused to rejoin the Republican Senate Caucus until the leader resigned because he had introduced bills to increase taxes and even introduced a gun control bill. I could not in good conscience sit under a leader who was introducing bills only a Democrat would introduce. Standing came at a cost.
I had my committee assignments taken away, my seniority taken away and my seat moved to the farthest side of the Virginia Senate chamber and my colleagues . All in an attempt to shame me into submission.
No matter what they did to me or said about me, I chose to stand.
---
|
# TAKING A STAND DURING COVID
---
|
# REFUSING TO WEAR A MASK
---
| During Covid, I refused to wear a mask. As a result, the Senate staff built a plexiglass wall around my desk. I referred to as my "Wall of Freedom."
Overnight, we saw America become a socialist nation. Our basic ability to breathe was now being governed by an overreaching tyrannical government.
Even the manufacturer of the masks printed a disclaimer stating the masks did not protect people from the spread of viruses. In fact, it was later proven that masks actually cause harm and increase a person's chances of contracting a respiratory virus.
I introduced many bills to make it illegal for employers, educators and even small businesses from violating our civil rights. These decisions of body autonomy we could determine for ourselves. I called on the government to stop restricting our ability to work, get educated or simply perform everyday activities like shop and visit the doctor for simply refusing the experimental jab.
I introduced legislation that would allow doctors to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid.
---
|
---
| Our Constitutional rights were being violated and I had to take a stand, no matter the cost. Wearing a mask or not should have been a choice, not a mandate.
---
|
---
| My colleagues complied with the mandates. I did not. I was both isolated and ostracized by my colleagues for standing. The Senate Clerk staff put my desk at the back of the room in a far corner. They tried to break me, but I stood strong.
---
|
---
| During the height of Covid, I was running for Governor. During the day I would serve in the Senate of Virginia. In the evenings, I campaigned across the state. No mask. No vaccine. People were desperate for someone who would stand up for them under the Constitutional mandates.
---
|
---
| Here's a picture of the Virginia Senate in 2021, during the height of Covid. We were forced to meet at the Science Museum of Virginia so that we could comply with social distancing mandates, which we've now discovered were a hoax and nothing more than political science.
---
|
---
| During the height of Covid, who stood up for you? Who fought the unconstitutional mandates? I did. And it came at a cost.
---
|
---
| Who can you count on to stand with you in the future? Who has had the courage, fortitude and history of standing with you in the past?
Standing wasn't easy. Even comedian Jimmy Kimmel mocked me nationally for refusing to wear a mask. They wanted to break me, but I stood strong in the midst of isolation, being mocked and ridiculed.
I continued to challenge the mask and vaccine mandates. They were making decisions based on political science, not science. Today, 4 years later, we know know the truth.
You can count on me. I've stood with you in the past. I will stand with you in the future.
---
| | [WRIC INTERVIEW](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010vwPcdUBiSKU9bBOJbYrzCdX3lUx_8v4KikJw6Lic_AfXraV8SeIRauRaum2NPmhGnv7PiccakcamTv3VDmH2ikd3YkaFEyQ_8f9yUzkA6DDHvS53G0MjYnvs_JXyAPt3O1IpyoWKygt3xjfsV7ZHfl8utpkNPbZmX4HvjjyxidE5IgoCqH1iizqDqDc_Q7MZdDN1-Z9GZms2LRXFDeTRvILd1cUZCQ9_5pw5rs6yO-72pO0g4oDVEy5CNiaX_uO&c=Vu2z2LCdkRFDyxyWKVv0DYE9ySp8Bn95XiYazVvBlOu_vj5IAaShJQ==&ch=fk6ioEOeKJukpQWsnKGh3zH0s71JZhLCYws0psBISi30-fTNJOy08g==)
---
|
# I STAND FOR MEDICAL FREEDOM
---
| I did not get the jab. And I fought for your right not to get the jab. The government should not mandate an experimental "vaccine."
---
|
---
|

---
|
---
| Dr. Sheila Furey, the President of VAMFA Virginia Medical Freedom Alliance and I worked very closely together on legislation that I sponsored to push back against onerous and unconstitutional mandates.
---
|

---
|
---
| Pictured: Dr. Robert Malone, Senator Amanda Chase and Dr. Paul Marik.
Dr. Robert Malone was the inventor of the Covid vaccine. Although he took the jab, he later withdrew his support and is now actively exposing the truth about the side effects of the vaccine, to include death.
Dr. Paul Marik spoke as a subject matter expert on several of my medical freedom bills. People want choice not mandates.
---
|
# STANDING FOR THE 2ND AMENDMENT
---
| Many of you heard me speak at the 2020 VCDL Legislative Day at the Capitol when there were well over 50,000 gun loving Virginians who arrived in Virginia.
You can trust me to protect your gun rights. To me it's personal. You can trust me to stand up for the 2nd Amendment.
---

It's important that we put legislators on the record so that voters know how they will vote when we do have the votes and it does count. | | | | | The late Virginia Senator Eva Mae Scott (R-Amelia) and I speak at a press conference organized by The Family Foundation against the so-called Equal Rights Amendment. | STANDING UP FOR SECURE ELECTIONS MAKING SURE YOUR VOTE COUNTS | | When voters in my senate district went to cast their vote in 2020, many said that they couldn't vote because someone had already cast their vote for them. I was determined to investigate and get to the bottom of this, despite efforts to be shamed into not questioning the 2020 Presidential Election results. | | I flew to Arizona to witness the first ever full forensic audit so that I knew what legislation to introduce in Virginia. Clearly there was a national effort to steal our elections and what they were doing in Arizona was happening all across the country, but only Republican controlled legislators were able to investigate. I worked very closely with the Arizona legislature. My hope was to have a full forensic audit right here in Virginia, but the legislature was completely controlled by the Democrats. So I sought to expose what was happening across the country, and eventually right here in Virginia. | | Pictured: Arizona State Senator Wendy Rodgers, Senator Amanda Chase, Representative Mark Finchem and Senator Sonny Borrelli. | | The Voter Confidence Restoration Act was just one of many bills that I introduced to put the guardrails back on our Virginia elections and restore voter confidence in our elections. While my goal was ultimately a full forensic audit of the 2020 election, I knew that wouldn't happen with a Democrat controlled legislature. So, I led the effort to simply go back to our Virginia Election Law best practices prior to covid, back when we required photo ID to vote, we had an election day instead of an election season and there were no drop boxes. | | While in South Dakota at the Mike Lindell Cyber Symposium I founded the National Election Integrity Caucus for legislators across the country. Together we worked on and shared legislative ideas and bills to assist with our election integrity efforts. | | STANDING UP ON JAN 6 | I was there on January 6. But I did not go into the nation's Capitol. Many of us believed the 2020 Presidential Election was stolen and joining the protest at the Capitol in DC with President Trump to exercise our First Amendment right to free speech and to contest the election results. We were counting on Vice President Mike Pence to do the right thing. Unfortunately, he did not and his political career is over. I stand up for true election integrity. As a result, I was censured by the Virginia Senate with 3 Republicans joining. | | | | STANDING UP FOR SAFER COMMUNITIES LOCKING UP VIOLENT CRIMINALS | Over the past 8 years, I have introduced legislation to support our law enforcement to include the Law Enforcement Bill of Rights. I voted against repealing qualified immunity. | | YOU CAN TRUST ME TO STAND | When you are considering who you are going to support for State Senate in District 10, (Appomattox, Amelia, Buckingham, Cumberland, Prince Edward, Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa, Powhatan, Hanover and the Shady Grove precinct in Henrico) ask yourself who has the experience to start on Day One? The Republican Mass Meeting to fill Senator John McGuire's seat will likely occur this December 2024. The General Election will likely occur on January 7, 2025, the day before session begins. I am the only candidate running for state senate who will be able to hit the ground running on Day 1. In addition, you know that I'm pro-life, pro-gun, pro-school choice, pro-medical freedom, pro-election integrity because I have a history of fighting for you and have a voting record you can trust. I have 8 years of experience as a Virginia Senate. Plus I have an 8 year voting record you can trust. Today, I humbly ask for your financial support and your vote. | | Virginia State Senator (R-District 11) 2016-2023 | | == | | | | | | | | | == | | == | Authorized and Paid for by Friends of Amanda Chase | | | | Friends of Amanda Chase | P.O. Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? * It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, folks? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81589?t=6&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.

[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help me keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81589?t=7&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81590?t=8&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81591?t=9&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81592?t=10&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81593?t=11&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81594?t=12&akid=17398%2E878179%2EVH9pn2)
I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.

— Jon

# [Get rid of the electoral college NOW. Choose the president by popular vote](https://default.salsalabs.org/T126e43db-98ea-41c9-86f3-c528b737a76a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5c8d368e-b5d3-4d3b-9ac9-e17572af22cc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | It's time to get rid of the electoral college, and choose the president by the national popular vote. The winner should be the WINNER -- the one who got the most votes. Period. And we should make this happen NOW. This is a lot more doable than people think. Yes, we can do this via Constitutional amendment, which is a high hurdle, but states can also choose to award their electors to the national popular vote winner. And if enough make that choice, the national vote winner will be elected every time. [17 states have already agreed to do this](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9e7757c6-8de8-4c0a-9294-e6ef025aa495/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), once there are enough states to secure a majority. And with just a few more states on board, we'll have it. This can happen, and we can make it happen. We can end the stupidity, and welcome democracy. [**Add your name: Get rid of the electoral college NOW, and choose the president by popular vote.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T74d461ce-48d2-46e8-9eb8-b42211a6e49a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

October 16th is the _final_ FEC deadline before Election Day, which means we only have five days left before we close our books. After that, we share a report with the FEC of donors who have given over $200 to support our movement. **You haven’t chipped in yet this year, but there’s still time to make an impact before our deadline and Election Day. If you can, we’re asking you to step up for the first time this year before Wednesday at midnight. A donation of $7 will go towards helping elect state Dems and combating the dangerous, billionaire-backed Republican agenda of the billionaire-backed Republicans. With Election Day looming in just 25 days, we need to be ready to win more than just the White House if we plan to protect reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ freedoms, and equal access to the ballot for all.
