| | Dear Fellow Believer,

Can I ask a favor of you today?

Millions of Christians around the globe face severe persecution for their belief in Jesus Christ as their personal Savior. In places like Iran, Pakistan, or Iraq, abandoning a belief system like Islam can be a death sentence.

This can be a little hard for us to imagine in our fast paced western world today, can't it?

Here's a comforting truth: God's Word will not return void. Despite the grave dangers, and through the generous giving of compassionate people like you, God's Word breaks through the darkness and nourishes the souls of those suffering for their faith.

Do you believe He will complete His good work despite the danger?

We do too.

That's why Global Christian Relief is dedicated to meeting the needs of our faithful brothers and sisters in Christ, ensuring they can be a beacon of hope in their communities and continue to advance the Great Commission despite the risks they face.

**But here 's another truth we need to confront: we can't do this work alone. We urgently need your support to deliver the Bible--a crucial lifeline--to these persecuted Christians. **

Would you be willing to step forward and make a difference?

A gift of just $25 today can provide 5 Christians with their own copy of the Bible. $50 will supply a small group with Bibles, and $150 can equip an entire home church with the Word of God. Will you shine a light into the darkness by sharing the Word of God?

Send copies of God's Word right now into the darkest places and into the hands of those who want it most by giving at the link below. Can I count on you?

[Yes, You Can Count on Me! ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=38f7a2239520493b93fd4896d2acec2d&_e=onvjqcI8OdYJgdn9TV9RXZkMyQER3F0I7mavEQaU8_nbrJEIkmwaoTo9Qk2LfLdUfyclZdZPL1iHf7C9pSJe02gwXTmLSvL43ajEkn-YdAOvkW32eQTRhKa32CvSmdiv0r3u9AnFTiYTY0GLU6WX9QuYwLDugJb_UDSOmj7Bid6xqmxAz1PCv3O4sVIfZ_O4EdrXjZXXxBzOv3CBAwPHp40cO79eiPMQi4D95f-OYU3crC8Ap5A98Utdq88RSw1nfKbukOvWEaFxNG1B8R7IjeJh0sdmBGCkhZfGoz8jDcWmbX1vu6sPYeIovbNsJmPGc59Yz4tsWkJwfaLTuiiwSw%3D%3D)
Thank you for your compassion and support of our brothers and sisters in Christ.

In His service,
Dr. David Curry
President and CEO of Global Christian Relief

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2043%2E135344%2EPOxqQp)

Stop. *Record scratch. Freeze frame.*
You may be wondering how this girl:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241011-1-900&t=2&akid=2043%2E135344%2EPOxqQp)
Ended up here:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241011-1-900&t=3&akid=2043%2E135344%2EPOxqQp)
Serving my first of three tours in Iraq as a CIA analyst, working to understand terrorist and militia groups that were targeting US forces and Iraqi civilians and plotting against the U.S.
It started on 9/11. One of the big moments that changed my life.
I was 24 years old, and I happened to be in New York City on my second day of grad school. By the time the dust had settled, I knew that I wanted to go into national security and protect my country.
Several months later, the CIA came to campus and my favorite professor encouraged me to hear what they had to say. Not wanting to disappoint him, I went. I applied, got the job, and after a lengthy background check, I started in Langley as an analyst.
It wasn’t long before I found myself in Iraq, my first of three deployments.
Going from the national security world to politics was a major culture shock. For 16 years, I didn’t talk publicly about my work—when I posted on Facebook that I was thinking about running for Congress, people asked me if I’d been hacked. One thing I definitely hadn’t done was ask people for money.
To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. When you're running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, you can't take anything for granted.

|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-KipnskaXhbbphNV-5HOdw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo68QUP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041NjA3MFcDc3BjQgpnBUcsCWd5QRKFUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-KipnskaXhbbphNV-5HOdw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo68QUP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041NjA3MFcDc3BjQgpnBUcsCWd5QRKFUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-KipnskaXhbbphNV-5HOdw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo68QUP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041NjA3MFcDc3BjQgpnBUcsCWd5QRKFUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-KipnskaXhbbphNV-5HOdw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo68QUP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041NjA3MFcDc3BjQgpnBUcsCWd5QRKFUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-KipnskaXhbbphNV-5HOdw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo68QUP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ041NjA3MFcDc3BjQgpnBUcsCWd5QRKFUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thanks for considering standing with us. After months of pressure the Biden Administration finally began to publicly call for a ceasefire and release of all hostages in Spring of 2024. And after Biden withdrew from the presidential race, VP Harris launched her campaign committing to 'get a deal done now.' But now we see a dramatic shift in the Biden Administration's priorities. Far from a ceasefire and peace deal, the Biden White House is actively pushing more war. More war spells disaster for global peace, the United States and our democracy, and we cannot be silent at this pivotal moment in history. **Let 's Address This.**
Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1fb1334c-7c38-4b80-88f1-b1e000adc977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Biden has continued to ignore the Leahy Laws and arm Netanyahu, despite multiple credible reports that Netanyahu is committing war crimes.
On August 9 VP Kamala Harris responded to pro-peace activists upset about Israel's horrific siege on Gaza and said, "_I hear you, and I promise you we are working to finalize the ceasefire deal by working round the clock. We will get this done_." Even as late as September 26 Joe Biden [repeated his calls for ceasefire as Israel attacked Lebanon](https://substack.com/redirect/c03f93f4-c98c-41ed-82ca-53900c53958e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But by October 3, something changed. As Reuters [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/d0ed41bf-2ce8-4913-a912-3266d3d48580?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The Biden administration believes it is appropriate for Israel to continue with its [ground and air attacks on Hezbollah](https://substack.com/redirect/124ac4d9-5f8f-4fa2-8b48-80d7bbcc129c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for now, U.S. State Department spokesperson Matthew Miller said on Thursday, even as he acknowledged the risk of the operation in Lebanon expanding beyond Israel's current aims.
And now all pretense of peace is lost. [As Voice of America reported on October 10](https://substack.com/redirect/f0308c67-0a17-4ace-9364-8f3073d26cf5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> U.S. support for Israel's campaign to root out Hezbollah in Lebanon is a departure from the 21-day cease-fire call Washington made with allies in late September. According to the White House readout of President Joe Biden's phone call Wednesday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu -- the first direct conversation between the leaders since Israel's campaign in Lebanon -- Biden did not reiterate the cease-fire call to the Israeli prime minister.
This is particularly confounding, given that journalist Bob Woodward reports that President Biden knows Netanyahu has been lying to him all this time to avoid a ceasefire and release of hostage deal. Woodward quotes Biden as [saying](https://substack.com/redirect/6e02a122-3011-4770-bd35-2f144f9af665?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_That son of a bitch, Bibi Netanyahu, he 's a bad guy. He's a bad fucking guy_!"
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..EzYO37Pzo44LpzIzD9GK_YD4HB9basrHL43WmMIMa3w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150057218)
I have questions that I wish those in legacy media would ask the Biden administration:
* What does it say about Biden's judgement if he knows that Netanyahu is a "bad f*cking guy" but continues to arm him anyway?
* What message does it send to the 77% of Democrats and 61% of Republicans who demand cessation of arms to Netanyahu, that while Biden agrees with them that Netanyahu is untrustworthy, he continues to arm Netanyahu anyway?
* Why is Biden taking a position completely contrary to his promise to get a deal done, while ignoring the genocide in Palestine and hostages languishing in prison?

And why isn't legacy media demanding answers to these questions from the White House and the State Department? To put in perspective how devastating Biden's reversal is, this is where we are right now. In the last two weeks Netanyahu has:
* Killed [more than 2000 civilians in Lebanon](https://substack.com/redirect/74accba8-7dd5-4579-82f9-9fe8a1fa8050?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and injured more than 9500
* Killed [more than 100 healthcare workers in Lebanon](https://substack.com/redirect/36a79eba-0629-4633-830b-43495bb4b63e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Threatened [violence on Lebanon the same way the Israeli military leveled Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/15a9d21e-bc63-4a92-8d61-bb017c8a01db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Displaced [more than 1.2 million Lebanese citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/5de2fab3-0534-4cb8-9ab8-b196cef0c6ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (nearly 25% of the population)
* Shot and [killed unarmed civilians in Northern Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/b8638965-4d9d-450e-a57b-4da0d15eb302?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) trying to flee to safety
* Shot at and [injured multiple UN peacekeepers](https://substack.com/redirect/0040c4bf-7109-4ec4-b525-7303b38992cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Lebanon
* Arrested [American journalist Jeremy Loffredo](https://substack.com/redirect/31a83df8-f05f-43db-a78e-580be0285ade?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for reporting from Israel

This is the absurd "[de-escalation through escalation](https://substack.com/redirect/7453494b-0dc0-4c76-9122-ed7af547931b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" strategy that the Biden White House approved. And this is all in addition to the [at least 186,000 Palestinian civilians killed in Gaza over the last year](https://substack.com/redirect/eabf8f83-1564-4ca8-8f13-4147fe087f32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Additionally, and with Biden's support, Israel promises to[ aggressively attack Iran](https://substack.com/redirect/469aa8d4-b6ee-4f3d-9b67-7ca4af840e7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), possibly targeting its oil refineries. Such an attack would be devastating for the region and the world depending on the size and scale of the attack. As I [tweeted on October 1](https://substack.com/redirect/823a2167-9e99-4728-87f8-107fc5831bff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> As Israel bombed and invaded Lebanon and killed more than 1000 civilians the White House defended it as "De-escalation through escalation," even writing a press release praising Netanyahu. Now as Iran fires 120 missiles at Israel does the White House stand by that absurd slogan? What a complete failure.
Sadly the answer appears yes, as Biden continues to believe that continued escalation is the path forward. Never mind that more than 100 hostages were released through diplomacy last November, yet only a handful have been released through incessant bombing. And while we've been told this entire time that the siege on Gaza was to "bring home the hostages," even the hostage families have long recognized this claim as a lie--[even stating that ](https://substack.com/redirect/bf64fa67-5af5-4a44-9ed0-1f38f05f4a38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"_the Israeli government is keeping our families hostage_."
Finally, if the horrors of decades of war in Iraq and Afghanistan taught us anything, it is that war--especially war that indiscriminately targets and kills civilians--can never bring about peace. The vast majority of Americans, Palestinians, Lebanese, and Israelis want peace--yet Biden now joins Netanyahu in enabling more war. I fear this reckless decision will have drastic ramifications of increased hostilities and violence through expansion of war, perpetuating this vicious cycle. While I hope I am wrong, it is hard to believe a peaceful resolution is possible with the current violent strategy.
As of right now, it is still within Biden's power to enforce the Leahy Laws, stop arming Netanyahu, and put an end to his expanding war--one that has already killed 186,000 Palestinians by the Lancet's count, and more than 2000 Lebanese civilians. But without explanation, he refuses to act. In the meantime, hostages continue to suffer, children continue to be killed, and the war lobby continues to make record profits. None of that bodes well for the prospects of global peace right now, or of sustaining American democracy this November.
* * *

The Biden Administration's 180o reversal on a peace deal is jarring, unacceptable, and risks a repeat of Iraq and Afghanistan | | | Oct 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | After months of pressure the Biden Administration finally began to publicly call for a ceasefire and release of all hostages in Spring of 2024. And after Biden withdrew from the presidential race, VP Harris launched her campaign committing to 'get a deal done now.' But now we see a dramatic shift in the Biden Administration's priorities. Far from a ceasefire and peace deal, the Biden White House is actively pushing more war. More war spells disaster for global peace, the United States and our democracy, and we cannot be silent at this pivotal moment in history. Let 's Address This. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. | | ---|---|--- Biden has continued to ignore the Leahy Laws and arm Netanyahu, despite multiple credible reports that Netanyahu is committing war crimes. On August 9 VP Kamala Harris responded to pro-peace activists upset about Israel's horrific siege on Gaza and said, "I hear you, and I promise you we are working to finalize the ceasefire deal by working round the clock. We will get this done." Even as late as September 26 Joe Biden . But by October 3, something changed. As Reuters : The Biden administration believes it is appropriate for Israel to continue with its for now, U.S. State Department spokesperson Matthew Miller said on Thursday, even as he acknowledged the risk of the operation in Lebanon expanding beyond Israel's current aims. And now all pretense of peace is lost. : U.S. support for Israel's campaign to root out Hezbollah in Lebanon is a departure from the 21-day cease-fire call Washington made with allies in late September. According to the White House readout of President Joe Biden's phone call Wednesday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu -- the first direct conversation between the leaders since Israel's campaign in Lebanon -- Biden did not reiterate the cease-fire call to the Israeli prime minister. This is particularly confounding, given that journalist Bob Woodward reports that President Biden knows Netanyahu has been lying to him all this time to avoid a ceasefire and release of hostage deal. Woodward quotes Biden as , "That son of a bitch, Bibi Netanyahu, he 's a bad guy. He's a bad fucking guy!" I have questions that I wish those in legacy media would ask the Biden administration: What does it say about Biden's judgement if he knows that Netanyahu is a "bad fcking guy" but continues to arm him anyway? What message does it send to the 77% of Democrats and 61% of Republicans who demand cessation of arms to Netanyahu, that while Biden agrees with them that Netanyahu is untrustworthy, he continues to arm Netanyahu anyway? Why is Biden taking a position completely contrary to his promise to get a deal done, while ignoring the genocide in Palestine and hostages languishing in prison? And why isn't legacy media demanding answers to these questions from the White House and the State Department? To put in perspective how devastating Biden's reversal is, this is where we are right now. In the last two weeks Netanyahu has: Killed and injured more than 9500 Killed Threatened Displaced (nearly 25% of the population) Shot and trying to flee to safety Shot at and in Lebanon Arrested for reporting from Israel This is the absurd "" strategy that the Biden White House approved. And this is all in addition to the . Additionally, and with Biden's support, Israel promises to, possibly targeting its oil refineries. As I : As Israel bombed and invaded Lebanon and killed more than 1000 civilians the White House defended it as "De-escalation through escalation," even writing a press release praising Netanyahu. Now as Iran fires 120 missiles at Israel does the White House stand by that absurd slogan? What a complete failure. Sadly the answer appears yes, as Biden continues to believe that continued escalation is the path forward. Never mind that more than 100 hostages were released through diplomacy last November, yet only a handful have been released through incessant bombing. And while we've been told this entire time that the siege on Gaza was to "bring home the hostages," even the hostage families have long recognized this claim as a lie--"the Israeli government is keeping our families hostage." body:
Remembering our friend, inspiration and Rocky Mountain Voice champion Buz Koelbel
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
It's rally day! We hope to see everyone out in Aurora for President Trump's visit. If you can’t make it, don’t worry—our content team will be on the ground. Follow along with live updates on [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, October 11, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl

|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Ganahl: Remembering our friend, inspiration and Rocky Mountain Voice champion Buz Koelbel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Buz Koelbel was a force of nature — a builder of legacies, a man of unwavering principles and a guiding light for all who had the privilege of knowing him._
_As one of the founders of Rocky Mountain Voice, Buz’s vision extended beyond brick-and-mortar buildings. He understood that the heart of any community is not just in its physical structures, but in the stories it tells, the voices it elevates and the principles it upholds._
_To many of us at Rocky Mountain Voice, Buz wasn’t just one of our founders — he was a mentor, a cheerleader and a friend. Buz, along with his amazing wife Sherri, and I met when I joined the University of Colorado-Boulder business school board more than a decade ago. He LOVED his Buffs! His involvement wasn’t ever limited to strategic decisions or occasional meetings. Buz showed up. He was present, not just in body but in spirit. His passion for truth, fairness, and balance in media shone through every project we undertook. He believed in the power of a free press to shape a more informed and engaged community, but he also understood the importance of responsibility. For Buz, journalism wasn’t just about reporting the news — it was about cultivating an informed citizenry, one that could rise above the noise and see the bigger picture._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘High energy’ Trump to kickoff whirlwind sprint through four states in three days with Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Donald Trump is starting a three-day campaign tour in western states, kicking off in Aurora, Colorado on October 11, where he is expected to address gang violence and the effects of unsecured borders.
* After Aurora, Trump will head to Reno, Nevada, where he will propose eliminating taxes on tips for service industry workers, a policy impacting millions of workers, especially women and parents.
* On October 12, Trump will rally in Coachella, California, focusing on housing affordability issues, criticizing Kamala Harris' policies that have caused housing prices to surge, pricing out middle-class families.
* Trump's final stop will be Prescott, Arizona, on October 13, where he plans to discuss the border crisis and rising inflation, highlighting the economic challenges Arizona families have faced under Harris' administration.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[A view from both sides of the 29 Road Interchange ballot measure in Mesa County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Mesa County Commissioners approved a ballot measure to connect 29 Road to Interstate 70, a long-anticipated project to reduce traffic congestion as the population grows by 20-25% over the next 20 years.
* The project would be funded by bonds from the county's existing sales tax revenue, with no tax increase, and has a built-in 40% funding flexibility to adjust for inflation and unforeseen expenses.
* Critics, including Councilman Dennis Simpson, argue the project may not be necessary, could increase road safety risks, and primarily benefits developers rather than addressing urgent transportation needs.
* Supporters are confident the plan will gain CDOT approval, obtain federal grants, and benefit the region with improved infrastructure, including multimodal transportation, without raising taxes.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Reports of school threats, safety concerns surge in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Safe2Tell Colorado saw a 74% surge in safety-related reports in September 2024, with 4,729 reports, the highest since the program's establishment.
* The most common issues reported were suicide (354), bullying (305), and school safety concerns (253), reflecting heightened awareness following national incidents like a school shooting in Georgia.
* A 162% increase in reports was observed statewide compared to August, with 60% of interactions occurring in the Denver metro area.
* The rise in reports aligns with national trends of increased vigilance after high-profile tragedies, including threats (239) and planned school attacks (193).
* False reports constituted only 2.1% of the total, and officials encourage students to continue using Safe2Tell to ensure school safety.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado districts hope voters support tax measures for new school buildings, scholarships, and more](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CHALKBEAT COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Over 30 Colorado school districts are asking voters to approve nearly $7 billion in local tax measures for new school buildings, renovations, and staff pay increases.
* Districts are proposing bond measures for infrastructure projects and mill levy overrides for operational costs like teacher salaries and career education programs.
* Aurora and Adams 12 districts are requesting large bonds without raising taxes, while Harrison aims to fund scholarships and teacher salaries.
* Property taxes have risen, but many districts argue these increases haven't translated into sufficient school funding, prompting the need for additional local tax measures.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[DeSantis rips Harris again for butting into Milton response: ‘No role in this process’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis criticized Vice President Kamala Harris for politicizing the response to Hurricane Milton, stating she has no role in disaster response and has never offered support in previous storms.
* DeSantis emphasized that both Presidents Trump and Biden handled past storms without politicizing them and accused Harris of injecting herself into the situation for her political campaign.
* Harris had earlier criticized DeSantis for not taking her call after Hurricane Helene, accusing him of playing political games during a crisis, which DeSantis dismissed as a distraction from his focus on helping Floridians.
* Despite the tension with Harris, DeSantis praised President Biden for the federal support Florida has received during Hurricane Milton, and Biden reciprocated by acknowledging DeSantis' effective disaster preparedness.
* Harris participated in a FEMA briefing on Hurricane Milton but drew attention for appearing distracted and making an odd comment during the live broadcast.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ochsner: No on Arapahoe County 1A; keep taxpayer protections in place](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_As an Arapahoe County resident, I’ll be voting no on Ballot Issue 1A, a measure to permanently remove taxpayer protections in place under Colorado’s Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights, or TABOR. Let me explain._
_TABOR is a constitutional amendment that, among other things, limits the growth of local government spending to a reasonable annual rate based on inflation and local economic growth. Overcollected revenue must be returned to taxpayers unless voters give permission to exceed those limits. Issue 1A would allow the county government to keep and spend revenue that would otherwise be refunded in perpetuity. County officials wont say it, but that amounts to a tax hike._
_It’s how big government advocates try to spin the ability to tax and spend without restrictions. It’s never a good idea, but especially now given the state of our state and nation’s economy._

clean_body: Remembering our friend, inspiration and Rocky Mountain Voice champion Buz Koelbel | | | | PRESENTED BY | | Hi friends, It's rally day! We hope to see everyone out in Aurora for President Trump's visit. If you can’t make it, don’t worry—our content team will be on the ground. Follow along with live updates on , , and ! This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, October 11, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | TODAY'S TOP STORIES BY HEIDI GANAHL, Buz Koelbel was a force of nature — a builder of legacies, a man of unwavering principles and a guiding light for all who had the privilege of knowing him. As one of the founders of Rocky Mountain Voice, Buz’s vision extended beyond brick-and-mortar buildings. He understood that the heart of any community is not just in its physical structures, but in the stories it tells, the voices it elevates and the principles it upholds. To many of us at Rocky Mountain Voice, Buz wasn’t just one of our founders — he was a mentor, a cheerleader and a friend. Buz, along with his amazing wife Sherri, and I met when I joined the University of Colorado-Boulder business school board more than a decade ago. He LOVED his Buffs! His involvement wasn’t ever limited to strategic decisions or occasional meetings. Buz showed up. He was present, not just in body but in spirit. His passion for truth, fairness, and balance in media shone through every project we undertook. He believed in the power of a free press to shape a more informed and engaged community, but he also understood the importance of responsibility. For Buz, journalism wasn’t just about reporting the news — it was about cultivating an informed citizenry, one that could rise above the noise and see the bigger picture. | Former President Donald Trump is starting a three-day campaign tour in western states, kicking off in Aurora, Colorado on October 11, where he is expected to address gang violence and the effects of unsecured borders. After Aurora, Trump will head to Reno, Nevada, where he will propose eliminating taxes on tips for service industry workers, a policy impacting millions of workers, especially women and parents. On October 12, Trump will rally in Coachella, California, focusing on housing affordability issues, criticizing Kamala Harris' policies that have caused housing prices to surge, pricing out middle-class families. Trump's final stop will be Prescott, Arizona, on October 13, where he plans to discuss the border crisis and rising inflation, highlighting the economic challenges Arizona families have faced under Harris' administration. | The Mesa County Commissioners approved a ballot measure to connect 29 Road to Interstate 70, a long-anticipated project to reduce traffic congestion as the population grows by 20-25% over the next 20 years. The project would be funded by bonds from the county's existing sales tax revenue, with no tax increase, and has a built-in 40% funding flexibility to adjust for inflation and unforeseen expenses. Critics, including Councilman Dennis Simpson, argue the project may not be necessary, could increase road safety risks, and primarily benefits developers rather than addressing urgent transportation needs. Supporters are confident the plan will gain CDOT approval, obtain federal grants, and benefit the region with improved infrastructure, including multimodal transportation, without raising taxes. | Safe2Tell Colorado saw a 74% surge in safety-related reports in September 2024, with 4,729 reports, the highest since the program's establishment. The most common issues reported were suicide (354), bullying (305), and school safety concerns (253), reflecting heightened awareness following national incidents like a school shooting in Georgia. A 162% increase in reports was observed statewide compared to August, with 60% of interactions occurring in the Denver metro area. The rise in reports aligns with national trends of increased vigilance after high-profile tragedies, including threats (239) and planned school attacks (193). False reports constituted only 2.1% of the total, and officials encourage students to continue using Safe2Tell to ensure school safety. | Over 30 Colorado school districts are asking voters to approve nearly $7 billion in local tax measures for new school buildings, renovations, and staff pay increases. Districts are proposing bond measures for infrastructure projects and mill levy overrides for operational costs like teacher salaries and career education programs. Aurora and Adams 12 districts are requesting large bonds without raising taxes, while Harrison aims to fund scholarships and teacher salaries. Property taxes have risen, but many districts argue these increases haven't translated into sufficient school funding, prompting the need for additional local tax measures. | Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis criticized Vice President Kamala Harris for politicizing the response to Hurricane Milton, stating she has no role in disaster response and has never offered support in previous storms. DeSantis emphasized that both Presidents Trump and Biden handled past storms without politicizing them and accused Harris of injecting herself into the situation for her political campaign. Harris had earlier criticized DeSantis for not taking her call after Hurricane Helene, accusing him of playing political games during a crisis, which DeSantis dismissed as a distraction from his focus on helping Floridians. Despite the tension with Harris, DeSantis praised President Biden for the federal support Florida has received during Hurricane Milton, and Biden reciprocated by acknowledging DeSantis' effective disaster preparedness. Harris participated in a FEMA briefing on Hurricane Milton but drew attention for appearing distracted and making an odd comment during the live broadcast. | As an Arapahoe County resident, I’ll be voting no on Ballot Issue 1A, a measure to permanently remove taxpayer protections in place under Colorado’s Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights, or TABOR. Let me explain. TABOR is a constitutional amendment that, among other things, limits the growth of local government spending to a reasonable annual rate based on inflation and local economic growth. Overcollected revenue must be returned to taxpayers unless voters give permission to exceed those limits. Issue 1A would allow the county government to keep and spend revenue that would otherwise be refunded in perpetuity. County officials wont say it, but that amounts to a tax hike. It’s how big government advocates try to spin the ability to tax and spend without restrictions. It’s never a good idea, but especially now given the state of our state and nation’s economy. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 9 All of the voter resources available to English-language speakers and readers are also available to Spanish-language speakers and readers in Colorado through VayaVotarColorado.gov, the office of Secretary of State Jena Griswold has announced. **Josh Hawley went 55 days without holding a public campaign event. **
But yesterday, he slummed it back to Missouri for a taxing one-day tour. And instead of traveling like any normal person, he kept up his luxury lifestyle by cruising between stops in a multi-million dollar private jet:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/05ef46aa-c49e-46f9-9d78-d8f721aba0c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Missourians know Hawley is an out-of-touch elite. **
They know that he's treated Missouri like flyover country since the day he stepped foot in the U.S. Senate -- proudly rejecting every opportunity to invest in our communities and even refusing to spend any real time in Missouri during his first re-election campaign.
That's why -- since our campaign has been able to expose Hawley and air that message on TV -- multiple polls show we've put this race within just a few points.
But now, with just 25 days until Election Day, we've got to continue holding Hawley accountable for abandoning our state and continue closing the gap in this neck-and-neck race. So I'm humbly asking:
**Will you chip in $10 or more to my grassroots campaign today? **
We have a real chance to defeat Josh Hawley and take back Missouri's U.S. Senate seat this year -- and I won't be able to do it without your help.

In a toss-up election (and remember, four of the last six presidential elections in Wisconsin have come down to less than 1%), the victory often goes to the side that works harder. We call it the margin of effort. That’s why we need to pull out all the stops right now. The only way we win in November is if we get every Democratic voter to the polls. Republicans are pouring millions into this race, flooding the airwaves with attack ads, and doing everything they can to flip our state red. If we don’t fight back now, they could tip the scales in their favor. We can’t let that happen. That’s why we’re racing to raise $15,000 before midnight tonight to give us the resources we need to WIN on Election Day. | | | Experts agree that Wisconsin could be the tipping point state. But this isn’t isn’t just about winning — it’s about protecting our democracy. Because if Donald Trump and the MAGA Republicans take control, we could risk losing everything.
* Voting Rights
* Social Security
* LGBTQ+ Equality
* Reproductive Freedom
* And so much more...

Like Kamala Harris says, we are not going back. Not with so much at stake for Wisconsin and for our country. But with the race this close, we need all hands on deck to win in November. Every dollar donated will go toward our critical work of turning out voters, countering Republican attacks, and keeping Wisconsin blue. But we need to hit our $15,000 goal to keep our operations going through Election Day. We can’t do this without you. With just 25 days left, your support could be the difference between victory and defeat. [So will you chip in $10 right now to fuel our fight?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tea7b30d1-6ce4-4eba-b654-70f8da91ee36/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Kelly Morrison
subject: October campaign update 👻🎃
body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hello & Happy October!
I hope this finds you well. Can you believe we are only 26 days away from the Election? Time is flying by, and I could not be more grateful for this grassroots team. With your support, we blew past our end of quarter goal last week and entered the last quarter of the year strong. Thank you so much for your support!
I want to take a moment to give you an update on the campaign:
With November right around the corner, our team is working hard campaigning not just for our campaign, but for Democrats up and down the ticket. From our incredible State House candidates to electing Governor Walz and VP Harris to the White House, every seat matters . We had a joyful rally when the Reproductive Freedom Bus stopped in Minnetonka, and I joined Minnesota’s First Lady Gwen Walz, Senators Amy Klobuchar and Tina Smith, and other incredible leaders in our state to stress the importance of voting blue this November.
Photo of Kelly speaking to a crowd at the Reproductive Freedom Rally [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/people/rf-rally.png]
We’re continuing to team up with campaigns all across MN03 to knock doors and get out the vote. Our intern program has been instrumental in helping us exceed our field goals - I am so grateful for them! I hope you get the opportunity to meet them on the doors over the next few weeks.
My schedule has been busy meeting voters all across the district. Most recently I had the honor of visiting Ridgepoint Senior Living in Minnetonka, Applewood Pointe in Champlin, and Friendship Village in Bloomington. We also hosted a postcard writing party in Bloomington where we had a fantastic turnout of incredible supporters!
Photo collage of Kelly at a variety of events [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/people/2410_event-collage.png]
My days are otherwise full with meetings, fundraising call time, and strategizing with my team on the best way to keep this seat blue. I am so proud of my team and the campaign they are running. We are not taking anything for granted and are ready to run through the tape on November 5th.
And no matter how busy my calendar gets, I will always find time to cheer for our Minnesota teams and I could not be more excited about the Vikings’ 5-0 start and the Lynx heading to the WNBA finals! 🏈🏀
This campaign would not operate at this rate without you, our team of grassroots supporters. I am so grateful, and I’m excited to continue this work with you over the next 26 days!
With gratitude and resolve,
Kelly
View or share this email as a webpage » [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/emails/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/3DAZVxyfjsqLRSXhRTU6IQnsg9uMD_RWymAan1enQgG_archive]
https://www.facebook.com/KellyMorrisonForCongress [https://www.facebook.com/KellyMorrisonForCongress] https://twitter.com/Morrison4MN [https://twitter.com/Morrison4MN] https://instagram.com/kellymorrisonforcongress [https://instagram.com/kellymorrisonforcongress] kellyforcongress.org [kellyforcongress.org]
I've spent most of my career as a doctor, not a politician. I'm running for Congress because I believe we need leaders who are focused on delivering results for Minnesota families. I'm not taking a cent of corporate PAC or lobbyist money , so I'm counting on folks giving what they can, when they can. Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can?
Donate $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-email?refcode=emailfooter&amount=10&type=rbtn]
Email is the best way to keep our supporters up to date on the campaign.
If you only want to receive our most important emails, click here to receive fewer emails. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/hHyPtKcXyUeK_xcY7BEsAQ2]
We’d hate to see you go, but if you want you can unsubscribe here [https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/4Dh5T9ni_kaWmPt-auzpZw2?unsubscribedata=KOdjVErvwBCB1VugmF9B2I8fx%2BR5tycu63LEeQLceHfTw%2FoUGrM4wUzvuj%2BUhaYRsf8eQUmeQ7V05qf0rYkWkGMviabMy7xuMiXZnmeJxCKaLjGB1BRFP2K7htGpIJ8DyFcioR0NvoJxckBUJmD7KxoEEgTLhejQAhEYhZrkr4PjxiCQ4azPdmJ35K%2BP7qbe0yEBFZ2iRU%2BLPhX9l%2B%2BEdovpkOZlUuohUna94SsK9UWHkmcNnPwM1f6hajTqXCMClVlvKfFU689vxhgAd6Fp8zixtWHNUXLJR3AuDbjbwOxK%2FQNnx5RLF%2Bd1B%2FvRLSf7NkahDC2YlsKcixhmSM7HEFM4hMS3XokgyTQhkm1ggsiJ58TiZJoecQlqY%2Fhg79wyS2P5TSBY0QCkjM2yMUze41xH6QVlle7br%2FDOayV5BevTrMNu0sNTxGnP%2BZjGvPrk] .

Peter,

With our election approaching, I wanted to update you on where things
stand in WI-03 with some positive news and some more concerning
developments.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-cooke.zGw32x&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241011_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=3998%2E35263%2EnI2Ly8 ]But first, I have to ask: will you help us hit our fundraising goal

name: Becca Balint
subject: Celebrating courage on National Coming Out Day
body:
Let’s uplift those who are out and proud, and hold a seat at the table for those who aren’t.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94807385/504609443/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWI4ZDU0ZC1lMjg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KtLk1xSl0v2aM--WnFvO4swxF57W42sF7cDBlfPywrs=&emci=0509bcd5-6a86-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2eb8d54d-e287-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=43402272) | Hi Peter, Today, on National Coming Out Day, I want to acknowledge the courage it takes to live openly as an LGBTQ+ person. **This day is about celebrating authenticity — whether that means celebrating loud and proud with your community or finding the strength to be true to yourself in private.** Growing up, I never imagined that someone like me — someone who faced fear and uncertainty over how their community would see them — could hold public office. Being the first openly LGBTQ+ person and the first woman to represent Vermont in Congress has been a deeply personal journey. And it’s our community in Vermont that has been one of my greatest sources of strength. But I also know that not everyone can come out. Safety, acceptance, and personal circumstances mean that staying private is the best or only option for many. **Today isn’t just about who steps out in their truth — it’s also about standing with those who can’t or were never able to.** LGBTQ+ rights are in question across the country. It’s all the more essential that we uplift our community. We’re fighting not only for visibility, but also for the right to live freely and safely, whether you’re out or not – and that is one of my top priorities in Congress! This National Coming Out Day, let’s celebrate the diversity of the LGBTQ+ experience in all of its beautiful forms. Let’s uplift those who are out and proud, and hold a seat at the table for those who aren’t. And together, let’s continue to fight for a world where everyone can live authentically — without fear. Happy National Coming Out Day,
Becca Balint

### **Bring Back Economic Security and Prosperity!**
---
Bad news for those banking on winning the lottery to help ease the pain of rising prices.

Starting next year, a ticket for the Mega Millions Lottery will go from $2 to $5, a whopping 150% increase!

It isn’t just the lottery that is costing more. September’s inflation numbers were released yesterday and came in higher than expected.

Take groceries, for example. Prices went up in just about every category of food items, with _eggs costing 8.4% more_!

Transportation costs were up again last month also. Would you believe we’ve experienced _56% auto insurance inflation_ since the Biden-Harris Administration took over?

**I am the only person in this Congressional race who has a plan to cut prices for Minnesota’s families and restore the economy.
**
You’ve likely seen my Make Minnesota Affordable Again plan over the last few weeks, where I’ve outlined four policies economists agree will bring down inflation and strengthen the economy.

Congress needs to cut wasteful federal spending, increase access to clean and affordable energy, reduce taxes, and help create high-paying jobs.

The trillion-dollar question is this: _What will it take for Congress to work together to pass sound policies and turn things around_?

We need elected officials willing to put politics aside, work across the aisle, and get things done for the American people. It is exactly these things that have defined my career, and this is the reason I’m running for Congress.

**I am committed to working in Congress to restore economic security and prosperity for Minnesota’s Third District and all Americans.
**
You shouldn’t need to win the lottery to live comfortably in this country.

I hope you’ll join me in this effort to Make Minnesota Affordable Again by voting for me in this election.

clean_body: | | Bring Back Economic Security and Prosperity! Bad news for those banking on winning the lottery to help ease the pain of rising prices. Starting next year, a ticket for the Mega Millions Lottery will go from $2 to $5, a whopping 150% increase! It isn’t just the lottery that is costing more. September’s inflation numbers were released yesterday and came in higher than expected. Take groceries, for example. Prices went up in just about every category of food items, with eggs costing 8.4% more! Transportation costs were up again last month also. Would you believe we’ve experienced 56% auto insurance inflation since the Biden-Harris Administration took over? I am the only person in this Congressional race who has a plan to cut prices for Minnesota’s families and restore the economy. You’ve likely seen my Make Minnesota Affordable Again plan over the last few weeks, where I’ve outlined four policies economists agree will bring down inflation and strengthen the economy. Congress needs to cut wasteful federal spending, increase access to clean and affordable energy, reduce taxes, and help create high-paying jobs. The trillion-dollar question is this: What will it take for Congress to work together to pass sound policies and turn things around? We need elected officials willing to put politics aside, work across the aisle, and get things done for the American people. It is exactly these things that have defined my career, and this is the reason I’m running for Congress. I am committed to working in Congress to restore economic security and prosperity for Minnesota’s Third District and all Americans. You shouldn’t need to win the lottery to live comfortably in this country. I hope you’ll join me in this effort to Make Minnesota Affordable Again by voting for me in this election. | | Please visit and follow us on social media to get involved and gather more information on my campaign. | Thank you, Minnesota, for entrusting me with the opportunity to serve you. | | Dear Friends,

The presidential election next month is a pivotal moment in American history and people of faith have a significant role to play.

Last Wednesday, I met with vice presidential candidate Sen. JD Vance in Arizona to discuss why people of faith should vote for former President Donald Trump. It was a thoughtful discussion on the importance of religious liberty and how Trump is the only one in this race who has demonstrated support for this God-given right of the American people.

My wife Alisha and I also published an editorial in the Deseret News discussing our first hand experience with Donald Trump during my campaign. We wholeheartedly endorse him for president and we encourage each of you to read and share it on social media.

Reach out to your friends and family who live in battleground states like Arizona and Nevada. Every vote will matter in this very close election. Your efforts will help us defend our rights and perpetuate our liberty for generations to enjoy.

Yours in freedom,
Trent Staggs

name: Emily Randall
subject: Coming out 🏳️‍🌈
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress
body:
I’m in a position of power. Every time I come out, I make it safer for the next person — which matters even more when right-wing legislators are passing hundreds of bills making life more dangerous for LGBTQ+ folks.

| **Peter — I want to wish you a wonderful, vibrant, life-affirming National Coming Out Day!** During winter break of my sophomore year of college, in the parking lot of Target, I told my mom I was dating a girl. She was wonderful, accepting, and warm. It wasn't such an easy conversation with everyone, but I feel so lucky to have been met with support from my nearest and dearest — even if I still don't like the idea of having to seek acceptance for just being me. But it turns out, as the first openly queer member of the Washington State Senate, I had to come out again and again. [_**I wrote about my experience as an out, visible, queer elected official in _Teen Vogue_ — please read it and share it on your social media platform of choice →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94810138/504617882/1341807646?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.10.11_ComingOut_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzN2IwOTBhMS1lNjg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uQ-zECdjRBVAABwEdzSbyJAQC4l6VKkPbTtS1pVn1Jg=&emci=cfd51214-4887-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=37b090a1-e687-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=23483442) The first time I “came out” to my colleagues in the legislature, I was testifying in support of my bill to create an LGBTQ veterans coordinator at the State Department of Veterans Affairs. One of my fellow legislators asked what the Q meant and why we weren’t using LGBT. I found myself at work, live on TVW (our version of C-SPAN), talking about my romantic life, my queer identity — that if I weren’t already with my amazing partner, Alison, I might fall in love with a person of any gender. It was surreal — and not a conversation I imagined I’d ever have at work! But I recognize that coming out is a privilege and a responsibility. I’m in a position of power. Every time I come out, I make it safer for the next person — which matters even more when right-wing legislators are passing hundreds of bills making life more dangerous for LGBTQ+ folks. And because that danger still exists, not all of my LGBTQ+ friends and fellow humans are able to live their truth out loud. So — as a person, as a healthcare and education advocate, and (with your help!) the next congresswoman from Washington’s 6th District, I support my queer siblings and neighbors. I support those who are loud about it and those who aren't. **I support you because you are human — and you are worthy of support.** Please read [_**my piece in _Teen Vogue_**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94810139/504617885/1341807646?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.10.11_ComingOut_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzN2IwOTBhMS1lNjg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uQ-zECdjRBVAABwEdzSbyJAQC4l6VKkPbTtS1pVn1Jg=&emci=cfd51214-4887-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=37b090a1-e687-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=23483442) and learn more about National Coming Out Day from our friends at the [_**Human Rights clean_body: I’m in a position of power. Every time I come out, I make it safer for the next person — which matters even more when right-wing legislators are passing hundreds of bills making life more dangerous for LGBTQ+ folks. | Peter — I want to wish you a wonderful, vibrant, life-affirming National Coming Out Day! During winter break of my sophomore year of college, in the parking lot of Target, I told my mom I was dating a girl. She was wonderful, accepting, and warm. It wasn't such an easy conversation with everyone, but I feel so lucky to have been met with support from my nearest and dearest — even if I still don't like the idea of having to seek acceptance for just being me. But it turns out, as the first openly queer member of the Washington State Senate, I had to come out again and again. The first time I “came out” to my colleagues in the legislature, I was testifying in support of my bill to create an LGBTQ veterans coordinator at the State Department of Veterans Affairs. One of my fellow legislators asked what the Q meant and why we weren’t using LGBT. I found myself at work, live on TVW (our version of C-SPAN), talking about my romantic life, my queer identity — that if I weren’t already with my amazing partner, Alison, I might fall in love with a person of any gender. It was surreal — and not a conversation I imagined I’d ever have at work! But I recognize that coming out is a privilege and a responsibility. I’m in a position of power. Every time I come out, I make it safer for the next person — which matters even more when right-wing legislators are passing hundreds of bills making life more dangerous for LGBTQ+ folks. And because that danger still exists, not all of my LGBTQ+ friends and fellow humans are able to live their truth out loud. So — as a person, as a healthcare and education advocate, and (with your help!) the next congresswoman from Washington’s 6th District, I support my queer siblings and neighbors. I support those who are loud about it and those who aren't. I support you because you are human — and you are worthy of support. Did you watch the town hall, friend?

**Kamala Harris has done it again. She's reminded us why she's the best person to lead our great country forward toward progress. **
She emphasized her commitment to **EXPANDING** affordable health care, **RESTORING** reproductive freedom and **PROTECTING** Social Security and Medicare — all in an effort to deliver more opportunities to Americans.

body:
Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

| | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=03b040fc86a24d9ab5aa99bdca550718&_t=NIz9ovpc6HGc_sdgqPhoxrYFwWdla0u5WRelS-u2tGB9wzhDQ9RE0VsuSsiGy1PoJybG3N14GJyoyCLGC1_dGdgno7-S0TrbcACiHNfbjkcoGVNrOosfNhzx3w3MnNCG)_

| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=03b040fc86a24d9ab5aa99bdca550718&_e=CkGO-LN0a1e8RWf_TB6BYtSCq9NSkfiT30aANpzCfLSvhxVQkXwslr80J2FJb4vxG9tvyN7pQhvXm5oaWHh6ZLSqMGwBlVjCB9napvJWLLWHPCgdpQ4oCPsWgDpd_udYkfCOA1uXJk9utCVSuHl6EE9E1K_GzCTrmZDCdfNIJOENK5BKOyqPsAOhpHob9hTp8GgScP7YqfucjQ3gDqU4-XfGF7aAlAU_ytIRtCF29Qf3aGTh2cni2rcPBuM-fwCdTl_b6Kf6D__pP0B7ZO5epdj7pgNTcewxtDWDYdosGJt5HXSNQtSawWyO2DHKlh2tbGTsMPduJDfNYgxHSJecmzEk_yNpJSK0AMbvv00B-PGek6d8ctgGmkpEWJhzhgGm5WXatzSfaHCJroqs3e5ffg%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=03b040fc86a24d9ab5aa99bdca550718&_e=CkGO-LN0a1e8RWf_TB6BYtSCq9NSkfiT30aANpzCfLSvhxVQkXwslr80J2FJb4vxG9tvyN7pQhvXm5oaWHh6ZLSqMGwBlVjCB9napvJWLLWHPCgdpQ4oCPsWgDpd_udYkfCOA1uXJk9utCVSuHl6EE9E1K_GzCTrmZDCdfNIJOENK5BKOyqPsAOhpHob9hTp8GgScP7YqfucjQ3gDqU4-XfGF7aAlAU_ytIRtCF29QdqnwLiMJ8hGAuOKcbISRWIqK9-AJWISbhUg9bd3LyKc4zYsDXS5-OM8IAmeotgQPDQtr1U03l7tNtZzwddwZ0jL3eKLgDOBaWC2pmrCOpMhPP5YFvJzQ-TKDK7iHiVGJqg4Dgc-D85dCcuSgcY6M-Q0qsde3_iwHjbnNq_UAdazQ%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=03b040fc86a24d9ab5aa99bdca550718&_e=CkGO-LN0a1e8RWf_TB6BYtSCq9NSkfiT30aANpzCfLSvhxVQkXwslr80J2FJb4vxG9tvyN7pQhvXm5oaWHh6ZLSqMGwBlVjCB9napvJWLLWHPCgdpQ4oCPsWgDpd_udYkfCOA1uXJk9utCVSuHl6EE9E1K_GzCTrmZDCdfNIJOENK5BKOyqPsAOhpHob9hTp8GgScP7YqfucjQ3gDqU4-XfGF7aAlAU_ytIRtCF29QfCS574SnQHldRgVD6D0qs6vFC_ft_jEOwAZVj28M6BUAJw-GwiQdBrwMp6uyp-q9qPjV9opKRp-UZV0Y4pbyR8ySMq6duQ3RQEEKkK3Ztbg-8MaN1vBKnohL2BQPqI4Ab6TY1yVmLzvrZxaz7wwWzTlR0f0nqCHoBkT6CyD6Z_xg%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=03b040fc86a24d9ab5aa99bdca550718&_e=CkGO-LN0a1e8RWf_TB6BYtSCq9NSkfiT30aANpzCfLSvhxVQkXwslr80J2FJb4vxG9tvyN7pQhvXm5oaWHh6ZLSqMGwBlVjCB9napvJWLLWHPCgdpQ4oCPsWgDpd_udYkfCOA1uXJk9utCVSuHl6EE9E1K_GzCTrmZDCdfNIJOENK5BKOyqPsAOhpHob9hTp8GgScP7YqfucjQ3gDqU4-XfGF7aAlAU_ytIRtCF29QfJt93lKVr1Lop4WaS5vuDxWw1odcNTlF34N8BBtG3ZuWOArqFXa5lC3pXzodIQErOLe79EUUOGWUx9srRIXsntiqtIOJ5u4q67HWYQVTyWLzc-2_dpQEGbwbDLbQZJAT8KHhtU6Dm7FR5DASxQqcpbcElosi3BUEJNhFk5wR_5Hw%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This segment dives into the complexities of **polling and public opinion** in Pennsylvania, highlighting influential demographics and regional voting trends.

F&M pollster **Berwood Yost **and Muhlenberg pollster **Christopher Borick** shared insights you won't want to miss less than 30 days out from the general election.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Founding Editor of Real Clear Pennsylvania, Charles McElwee, **shared that areas such as Cumberland County are shifting trends in PA, mentioning that "these suburbs are increasingly leaning Democratic, which may have long-term implications for future electoral outcomes".** **[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4d341039a0&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Director at Floyd Institute for Public Policy Center for Opinion Research Franklin & Marshall College,****Berwood Yost** defends random sampling and its significance towards the larger population, describing the transparency of public opinion polling.** **[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3f85e10723&e=b7b3eddce2)]** **
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* From June to October, satisfaction among PA voters with presidential candidates**rose by 18 points to 58%** , following Joe Biden's exit from the race. [[C](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=61c9520bdb&e=b7b3eddce2)[ommon Ground Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0d0e7f862c&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* 46% of **PA voters say they are “worse off” than a year ago** , a sentiment consistent over recent years. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=77c2e33859&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* The economy, particularly **unemployment and rising gas and utility prices** , remains the most frequently cited problem among registered voters in Pennsylvania, at 34%. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=516b138976&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* **Over half of all registered PA voters** surveyed say their economic conditions are worsening. [[Common](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=140aa92834&e=b7b3eddce2)[ Ground Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b5f355fd7e&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* 91% of PA voters **responded that they were "definitely voting"** in the 2024 presidential election. [[Muhlenberg](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8e242449b2&e=b7b3eddce2)[ Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=84b7f17837&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* If the election were held today, **Kamala Harris would defeat Donald Trump in PA** , 50% to 46%. [[Common Ground Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1f4c5b304c&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Explained: Why PA Polls Are Trustworthy**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a016507cbd&e=b7b3eddce2 "Why Joe Biden is in PA Every Other Week | Voices of Reason Ep. 3")
---
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
|
---
| _Pro-Harris vs. Pro-Trump Republican Debate_

Next week, tune in for a debate between two long-time Republican strategists, **Craig Snyder** and **Dennis Powell**. PA's swing state voters will determine who wins the presidency – each participant makes his case for the top of the ticket.
---
|
---
| _The Keystone Candidate Forum debuts next week!_

Our preview segment will feature **U.S. Rep. Scott Perry** , the incumbent congressman running for PA's 10th Congressional District.
---
| | Are you a candidate interested in participating in the forum? Reach out to [steve@politicspa.com](mailto:steve@politicspa.com?subject=Keystone%20Candidate%20Forum%20Inquiry) for more details or to secure your spot!
---
| The Keystone Candidate Forum is a collaborative series hosted by _Voices of Reason_ , sponsored by the PA Chamber of Business & Industry.

Our goal: **everyone gets a fair shake in the Keystone Candidate Forum** with the belief that balanced dialogue provides every candidate an unfettered platform to share their views.

The forum spotlights competitive races across Pennsylvania, including statewide elections and key swing districts that could shift the balance of power in the state legislature.

Airing in October, the forum will stream online and be broadcast across the Philadelphia metropolitan area, with detailed recaps featured in the _Voices of Reason_ newsletter.
---
| _In Case You Missed It..._
_Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=52e602949a&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3ef93f055e&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=aa82a03895&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8cd2f2e9f6&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a7a86f0821&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=03b8ab748e&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

None of the newspapers examined by Media Matters ran even half as many stories on Trump’s indictment as they did on Clinton’s emails.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94812377/504624909/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWVlNDBlZGUtZTk4Ny1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q26XuKGVbbusTb2dHYvpokEwGoINzX69g51fZ4PVrZk=&emci=7da7c1b0-e787-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=aee40ede-e987-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
With less than four weeks until Election Day, several potential "October Surprises" have emerged—most notably, explosive new documents from Trump’s January 6th indictment.
The documents reveal eye-witness testimony that Trump, when informed his supporters were threatening to hang Mike Pence, responded with, "so what." This devastating revelation adds to the evidence suggesting Trump aided and abetted a coup attempt.
**Yet a _Media Matters_ study shows that major newspapers are barely covering the story, publishing just 26 articles in the week after the filing. By contrast, those same papers ran 100 stories on the Clinton email "scandal" in a similar timeframe in 2016. **
That’s more than four times the coverage, Peter.
[**If you’re frustrated by the legacy media bias and want to help us fight back in swing states, can you chip in $17 to COURIER today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94812380/504624915/-260044646?refcode=20241011-EM-January6Bias&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWVlNDBlZGUtZTk4Ny1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q26XuKGVbbusTb2dHYvpokEwGoINzX69g51fZ4PVrZk=)
We all remember the 2016 election when James Comey's letter about additional Clinton emails led to 46 front-page stories in just one week.
**Clinton was never charged, but as data guru Nate Silver noted, the media’s fixation "probably cost Clinton the election."**
Now, eight years later, Trump’s federal indictment—backed by overwhelming evidence of his role in an attempted coup—barely gets a mention.
**None of the newspapers examined by Media Matters ran even half as many stories on Trump’s indictment as they did on Clinton’s emails. At best, it’s an absurd overcorrection; at worst, it’s a complete dereliction of duty by the legacy press—especially at a moment when the foundation of our democracy is at stake.**

disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR BY
MONDAIRE FOR CONGRESS
body:
There’s so much for us to celebrate—and keep fighting for.
Happy National Coming Out Day, team!

As the first openly gay, Black member of Congress, _this day is deeply personal to me._ I can't express how much the world we live in today feels so different from the world I lived in growing up closeted.

As scary as it was at first, coming out was one of the best decisions I ever made. I'm proud of all the LGBTQ+ people living their truth and want anyone who may still be on their journey to know: there's a community ready to support you.

Today is a reminder that there's so much for us to celebrate—and keep fighting for. **Because there's a world out there where no one has to question whether it is safe to show up as they are.** A world where a kid like me growing up poor, Black, and gay can have the confidence to achieve anything he or she or they put their mind to—even becoming a member of Congress.

While we have made significant strides in the fight for LGBTQ+ equality, _we still have a long way to go._ The progress we've earned is being undone by far-right politicians, and **the challenges we face today underscore the importance of standing together.**

It's never been more clear that we need leaders in Congress who understand the struggles of the LGBTQ+ community and who will always stand in support of equality for everyone.

As we approach the beginning of Yom Kippur - this fast day is the holiest day of the year-- It is a time that we are supposed to be closest to G‐d. This Holiday is the Day of Atonement--"For on this day He will forgive you, to purify you, that you be cleansed from all your sins before [G‐d](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/aa5315c1-8f33-45ef-ac3d-1d9e019f7d2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" ([Leviticus 16:30)](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4a101398-c21b-40d4-adc6-25381f6a2c5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
