body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4066%2E35263%2E0XLQr7 ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter — Today is
National Coming Out Day, so I’d like to take a moment and share my own
personal story with you.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-oct24.yPYsfQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20241011_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=4066%2E35263%2E0XLQr7 ]Tammy Baldwin

When I came out in college, I knew that I wanted to pursue a career in
public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice
between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life
openly.

Seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by
coming out, celebrating who they are, and being proud about who they love
helped me realize that I could do both. I could both run for office and be
honest about who I am.

Thanks to the support of this remarkable, odds-defying team, I was elected
as the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. But I didn’t run
for office for the sake of making history,
Peter — I ran to make a
difference.

I knew that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a
difference in people's lives. Folks like you supported me because you
wanted to make a difference, too. And together, we’ve made incredible
progress — but our work isn’t over yet.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass
harmful anti-LGBTQ+ legislation, especially targeting the transgender
community and LGBTQ+ youth. Eric Hovde, my right-wing opponent, and
extreme Republicans threaten to advance a dangerous agenda that has made
anti-LGBTQ+ policies the hallmark of their platform if they succeed in
taking back control of the Senate.

Together, I know we can fight back against these harmful policies and can
continue our work to make a difference. But it’s going to take all of us
as I face my toughest reelection fight yet.

Let's be real about this: Shameless, partisan opponents of voting rights want to roll back early voting in Arizona because they think that if fewer people participate in Arizona's elections they'd be more likely to win and keep their power. They're willing to close the curtain on more than 30 years of progress just to win some elections.
This is about power, plain and simple, and they don't like when voters have it instead of them. RUSH $25 or more today to help fight back against the vote suppressors across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101124_2&amount=25]

AZ Mirror: More than 75% of voters use early ballots. Every AZ House Republican voted to take that away. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101124_2&amount=25]
This headline says it all, Team.
Arizona made "no-excuse" early and mail-in voting legal back in 1991. For decades, Arizona's mail-in voting laws were the model of ballot accessibility, making it easy for voters to participate in their elections. An overwhelming majority of Arizona voters voted early, either in person at a polling place or via mail-in ballot.
But opponents of voting rights in the Arizona House of Representatives just voted to change all that. They voted along straight party lines to pass a bill that would end early voting in the state -- both in person and by mail with just a handful of exceptions for the elderly or those in military service. This sends the bill onto the Arizona Senate, possibly setting up a showdown with Gov. Katie Hobbs over a potential veto.
This is bad news for Arizona voters and bad news for everyone that cares about our democracy. Help us stop suppressive bills like this in Arizona and across the country with $25 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101124_2&amount=25]

| | | **Stand with Us in the Fight **
**Against Drug Addiction**
---

Dear Peter,
We are at a tipping point in our district, state, and country with our drug addiction crisis. So many families have loved ones affected by this addiction, and little is being done to support them.

In Congress, Carmen Goers will meet with leaders to find ways we can provide help to those struggling with addiction but also hold them accountable. Carmen will also work with our Law Enforcement communities from Chelan to King County to ensure they are getting the tools they need to hold those dealing with these drugs accountable.

It’s time for real leadership.

---
| | | |
---
|
But we need your help to make this happen. With your donation, we can bring awareness to this critical issue and advocate for stronger policies that will make a real difference. Whether you can give $25, $50, or any amount, your contribution will help us take on this fight and build safer, healthier communities.

Able Dems proudly endorses Colin Allred for the US Senate representing Texas, recognizing his unwavering commitment to protecting underserved communities. As a civil rights attorney and former NFL linebacker, Colin understands the challenges faced by marginalized groups and has dedicated his career to advocating for their rights. In Congress, he has fought tirelessly to protect voting rights, improve access to healthcare, and promote fair housing—issues that resonate deeply with those who have been historically overlooked. In stark contrast, his opponent Senator Ted Cruz abandoned his constituents during a devastating winter storm, fleeing to Cancun while families struggled without power and water. This callous act revealed his lack of accountability and connection to the people he represents. **Colin's leadership is crucial as we strive for a more inclusive Texas, where everyone has a voice. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: Abortion is on the ballot. Peter, Abortion is one of the top issues in this election, and it's critical that voters know exactly what's at stake. = Here's a look into how Republicans are talking about abortion across the country: – In Montana, GOP Senate candidate, Tim Sheehy, is claiming all women are “indoctrinated” on abortion. Apparently it's radical for women to want control over their own bodies. – In Louisiana, the state made history by becoming the first state to officially begin classifying misoprostol and mifepristone, two drugs used in medical abortions, as schedule IV controlled substances. These vital medications, which can also be used to save women who are hemorrhaging during birth, just became nearly impossible to access. – In Florida, the state's Department of Health is threatening to bring criminal charges against a local TV station because they are running an ad to overturn the state's six-week abortion ban. – And in Texas, the Supreme Court of the United States has rejected the Biden administration's argument that federal law requires access to emergency abortion care even in states that restrict the procedure. Point blank: The GOP's stance on abortion hasn't changed one bit. They still want to control women's access to vital care. They are still using the courts to get their way. And they are still willingly allowing women to be put in harm's way for their own political gain. It's never been more clear that we need a pro-choice majority in the House. Dr. Kim Schrier is one of two pro-choice women doctors in Congress, and she's using her voice to advocate for women everywhere. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: The truth about Jim Jordan: Trump’s partner in crime
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
With each passing news cycle, it’s become more apparent that Trump committed multiple crimes leading up to January 6th.
And Jim Jordan, as the Chair of the House Judiciary Committee, has been doing everything he can to cover them up.
Many of us have seen the recently unsealed indictments, but if you haven’t, let me break it down:
The pages are filled with Trump's attempts to overturn the 2020 election by pressuring state officials, spreading lies, and inciting a violent insurrection that was criminal and treasonous.
But none of that matters to Jim Jordan.
He’s never cared about truth and honor before, so why start now?
He is more concerned with protecting Trump and his own involvement than standing up for justice.
Will you chip in $20, $50, or even $100 now to help us continue exposing Jordan's seditious behavior. We are on the verge of defeating him, but we need every dollar to reach voters and counter his lies. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241011_trump_indictment_link1]
Here’s the reality: Jordan defied a congressional subpoena and still refuses to testify about his role in planning and executing the events leading up to January 6th.
What does he have to hide?
Perhaps it’s the numerous phone calls he made to Trump’s team as they schemed to throw out legitimate votes in states like Georgia, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin.
Jordan knows he’s complicit, and that’s why he’s running scared, deflecting, and trying to protect himself by using his power to halt investigations and shield Trump.
Every moment Jim Jordan stays in office is a threat to our democracy.
His entire career has been about blocking progress, spreading misinformation, and defending a criminal president.
And now, when he can do the right thing and cooperate with investigations, he refuses – because he’s afraid of what will be uncovered.
We’re closing in on Election Day, and this is the most important congressional race in the country.
We need your support now more than ever to show Jim Jordan that his days of dodging accountability are over.
We have Jordan on the run, and he knows it.
Our campaign is reaching more voters and gaining momentum daily, but we must keep up the pressure.
Will you contribute today to help us continue the fight? We can’t allow someone who covers for Trump’s crimes and obstructs justice to represent us any longer. With your help, we’ll hold Jordan accountable, win this race, and restore integrity to Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241011_trump_indictment_link2]
25 days left until Election Day – let’s make every single day count. We’re building a team of volunteers to knock on doors, make calls, and get our message out. If you’re ready to join us in making history, sign up today! [http://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

| | Hi, Peter, I drive a truck, so I’m constantly on the lookout for good items people have thrown to the curb. Most in my household like to tease me about the “junk” I bring home, but recently, Freya was super excited to see that I had this electric quad bike in the back of my truck. Together, we did some troubleshooting and discovered that one of the two batteries didn’t hold a charge and the on/off switch was broken. So, we got a new battery, used a light switch (yes, like the one on your wall), and got the quad bike back up and running. Freya has been zipping around our yard ever since. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2049%2E135344%2EHlb_yL)

Yesterday afternoon, Donald Trump spoke in Detroit at the Detroit Economic Club. It was billed as an opportunity to present a series of plans to bolster the American auto industry, a topic that a lot of Michiganders are interested in.
But that’s not what we saw. Instead in the *2 hours* that Trump spoke, he aired personal grievances, lied about Michigan election laws, lied about having been named “Michigan Man of the Year,” and repeatedly insulted the great city of Detroit.
Absolutely not.
But the bigger message was not his words, but his actions. Trump’s repeated presence here in Michigan over and over and over again is the clearest signal of all.
Trump knows what we know: If he loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
That’s why Republicans are throwing everything they can at Michigan: Outside groups have already spent or committed more than $50 million in TV ads attacking me and propping up Mike Rogers.
And our state is virtually tied — recent public polls show a dead heat for both the presidential and the Senate race, Cook Political Report has our race rated as a pure toss-up, and the nonpartisan election forecasters have said there may be no state more important in the presidential race than Michigan.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day.
[**We can't let that happen. Want to help? Chip in what you can and help send a message that Michigan is sure as hell not ready to swing back to Trump.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241011-2-900&t=2&akid=2049%2E135344%2EHlb_yL)

Kamala finally admitted what we already knew.
| | | | | |
---
| Peter- This week, Kamala Harris finally admitted what we already knew: that she wouldn’t do a single thing differently than the current failures of the Biden-Harris Administration if she is elected. I also debated a poster-child for Trump Derangement Syndrome, a so-called “conservative” whose only argument in voting for Kamala Harris over Donald Trump is “Big Orange Man Bad.”
But first, my thoughts on the one-year anniversary of the October 7th terrorist attacks that we recognized this week.
One year ago this past Monday, we witnessed an act of pure evil. Terrorists murdered and kidnapped civilians in Israel, tearing families apart, leaving a nation in mourning, and shocking the Western world.
Peace, when confronted by malevolent groups like Hamas, cannot be achieved through appeasement. Securing it demands the will to defend freedom, sometimes by force, and always with courage.
In a world where radical ideologies thrive, those who cherish freedom must be ready to fight for it. Israel’s right to defend itself is the same right that safeguards all free nations. The United States and all of Western civilization must stand with Israel and the Jewish people against the barbarism of their neighbors in the Middle East, and antisemites around the world, who want to erase them from the face of the world.
We must never forget.
---
| | | |
---
| "NOT A SINGLE THING"
---
| |
---
| **[WATCH KAMALA HARRIS END HER PRESIDENTIAL PROSPECTS](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J9YDWQPE9YRX8DQNH91FMC76_0)** Welp, Kamala Harris basically obliterated the central thesis behind her candidacy for president this week.
Kamala Harris’s entire campaign is premised around her being a “change” candidate. Literally, the motto for her presidential campaign is: “New Way Forward.”
So, naturally, when Kamala Harris was asked on The View what she would do differently than Joe Biden as president, her answer was.... “NOT A THING.”
It is almost hard to believe until you watch her say it, so please watch the clip above to see for yourself.
As a reminder, Kamala Harris has sat by while Joe Biden:

* Unleashed inflation, raising costs for groceries, gas, rent, and everything else while wages have barely kept pace with rising prices.

* Opened our borders and mass paroled criminal illegals into our country, which led to the senseless deaths of innocent American women and girls.

* Fled Afghanistan in such horrific fashion that 13 Americans died, thousands of our allies were abandoned, billions in weapons were handed over to terrorists, and America’s credibility on the world stage was destroyed leading to unprecedented aggression from our adversaries.

Kamala wouldn’t change anything? “Not a thing” comes to mind?
This is what you’re going to get with a President Kamala Harris, the same failed policies packaged in a far-left, San Francisco radical.
Vote for Donald Trump.

| Debating liberals is one thing I enjoy in politics probably more than anything else. I like these debates because, usually, they are substantive discussions over which policies** are better suited to handle issues we all agree need to be addressed (immigration, foreign policy, taxation, etc.).
Debating someone who calls themselves a “conservative” while also endorsing Kamala Harris over Donald Trump was a new one for me. But I decided to do it anyways because I thought it was important to expose just how shallow the arguments against Donald Trump really are.
You can watch the debate above for yourself. The guy I was debating is the poster child for Trump Derangement Syndrome - none of his arguments were based on policy; all of his arguments were emotionally centered attacks on Donald Trump’s character.
It’s a long one, but it is worth your time if you want a few tactics for debating people like this you might encounter.

Fellow patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to speak directly to you because what is happening in Ohio will decide the future of our country. It’s that simple – if we win Ohio, we win the Senate majority. Period.

**We’re running out of time, and I can’t stress enough how critical every single day of this campaign is.** I’m crisscrossing this state, meeting people from all walks of life, and I’m hearing the same thing: Ohioans are fed up with the direction this country is heading in. They’re ready for real change, and we have a chance to give it to them by flipping this seat RED.

[**I can’t do this without you, fellow patriot.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4f13db1fc249422d9ddc471364262bdb&_e=h4YkT0QHaeGw5JkvmvVm458I3cQzeOU1aRSV6wCU-IOJXZ-J-gq_5Yurs6iGoeUGP33FpEQGjDCE3B8viXH4GVOmNV09ex6wqoXfDfqPZUDvHkNDVrULva9JhRF8vHPkGX3uXjW0OCI9g25qskBbqJRjbvAJTn38e_6IRHykxmrCnghqe40ipdEgynhT053AYjYeon5UO-eeCgsqbJB2Eohux0Re2aeoAxPwsnSGYv_E0ytDJWT7e6Nb7qx-o0BEuBw1BSG62_c8cE5N_yUvesIJ0PpkC5hJqEJngmQLQ5zgPOPbiBBtl_AzynjSi_2atQwzIfLzl-3yxq8Oadj79icR_rqYEDlWojB3jCz-RuV6E3xDj2yRHuzUQELcXBIwP7VoC6aheYs1DFA3s9t5yDcPDBC7u35RHQx4LTNqhyU%3D) With each passing day, Sherrod Brown and the radical left machine propping up his campaign are getting more and more desperate.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4f13db1fc249422d9ddc471364262bdb&_e=h4YkT0QHaeGw5JkvmvVm458I3cQzeOU1aRSV6wCU-IOJXZ-J-gq_5Yurs6iGoeUGP33FpEQGjDCE3B8viXH4GVOmNV09ex6wqoXfDfqPZUDvHkNDVrULva9JhRF8vHPkGX3uXjW0OCI9g25qskBbqJRjbvAJTn38e_6IRHykxmrCnghqe40ipdEgynhT053AYjYeon5UO-eeCgsqbJB2Eohux0Re2aeoAxPwsnSGYv_E0ytDJWT7e6Nb7qx-o0BEuBw1BSG62_c8cE5N_yUvehMX1KgidVJsF2EFLeXtksVdybXSwQExoe5LYe1So3bxSgSujntThaBBeWm7g_QUh2Sx96Nqm9zG0e7Iz46ziZ5Ep_1nDVpTOnKzFkAqubm2zLpIcEUegzQ-q-0ajYfkgYUIVciGvQXMZ-jGznDJEsM%3D)
We’re being massively outraised and outspent. Brown essentially has a blank check to place more ads, send more mailers, and mobilize more paid Democrat operatives around the state. **They have deep pockets, and we’re feeling the squeeze on our resources.**

[**We’re finalizing our budget for the remainder of this race, and I would greatly appreciate anything you can give to help us fire Sherrod Brown and flip this seat.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4f13db1fc249422d9ddc471364262bdb&_e=h4YkT0QHaeGw5JkvmvVm458I3cQzeOU1aRSV6wCU-IOJXZ-J-gq_5Yurs6iGoeUGP33FpEQGjDCE3B8viXH4GVOmNV09ex6wqoXfDfqPZUDvHkNDVrULva9JhRF8vHPkGX3uXjW0OCI9g25qskBbqJRjbvAJTn38e_6IRHykxmrCnghqe40ipdEgynhT053AYjYeon5UO-eeCgsqbJB2Eohux0Re2aeoAxPwsnSGYv_E0ytDJWT7e6Nb7qx-o0BEuBw1BSG62_c8cE5N_yUverdy-Ph3DldrCHB9TAliJ2XtX_HLMVbhQYGCtdvQNCWzLfIJ_MyYAe8Yi3Nmz3fDiXT6s2_xvde00sXuJlXbwaJh_GvFwvSj454jbTKF1EAGROWRVzDDeUP_ivOp0sgDGryiBTRQOESQZWutCSophdY%3D)

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Power of Rural Democrats
body:
Local parties are coming together like never before to build a rural resurgence.
| | | | | |
---
# Rural Democrats Are Being Heard.
---
|
---
The pandemic changed so much for so many Americans. There are a few silver linings amongst those clouds. The world learned how to be more digitally connected and connected across great distances. Rural America is all about great distances. For years, political organizing was an insurmountable challenge in certain districts. Upon No Dem Left Behind's founding, we recognized that obstacle and had a plan to address it. Our early virtual town halls utilized celebrity star-power to spotlight Dems in deep-red districts. Our ROCC forums taught the principles of organizing in a peer-learning environment. Our work on ARPA inspired activism in Republican-led counties. In short, our mission was to connect and empower rural Democrats to build the infrastructure to reshape the Electoral Map in the years to come.
---
|
---
The lesson? After the rain, comes flowers.
---
|
---
It's a pleasure to have you with us in this ongoing journey. And that's how rural Democrats are feeling. Our reward at No Dem Left Behind comes when we step into that local Dems meeting, when we partner and accomplish something together, we get that great, big "thank you". Thanks for recognizing us, remembering us, and making sure we never feel left behind. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...
---
| | | | | [→ Support Rural Democrats](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v1jrs-fdzdu4-kyd76rh0/)
---
To tomorrow's field of flowers. — No Dem Left Behind

body:
Dangerous, unhinged, and unfit for Minnesota.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1366%2E791427%2EZMFELc)

Friend — We were completely shocked and horrified to read the words tweeted by Matthew Brodsky, (now former) campaign manager for Ilhan’s GOP opponent and former White House advisor under Trump.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-oct24.fj-VLc&refcode=em241011-1-1&t=2&akid=1366%2E791427%2EZMFELc)
Yes, you read that right. No, there’s no context missing.
The person who has been managing Ilhan’s opponent’s campaign thinks that Israel should carpet bomb, and drop napalm on, Irish United Nations soldiers who are stationed in Lebanon for a multinational peacekeeping mission.
Not only would that be a violation of multiple international laws of war, but it’s a direct threat towards one of our allies, an affront to the entire spirit of the United Nations, and a callous, bloodthirsty call for violence.
**Let’s be clear, this kind of rhetoric from our opponent’s campaign is unacceptable. It’s dangerous, unhinged, and unfit for Minnesota.**

name: Dave Min for Congress
subject: ICYMI: OC Women In Leadership Support Dave Min
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/76903b77366e/icymi-oc-women-in-leadership-support-dave-min-18229519?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** October 11, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**ICYMI: OC Women In Leadership Support Dave Min**
**IRVINE, CA** — State Senator Dave Min has been an advocate for women and families his entire career. An advocate for a fairer economy since his time at the Securities & Exchange Commision and the Center for American Progress, Min has also passed a number of bills in concert with his wife Professor Jane Stoever to expand and protect the rights of domestic violence survivors. Senator Min was also a co-author of Proposition 1, which enshrined abortion rights in the California state constitution. Scott Baugh, by comparison has advocated for[ hitting children to teach them a lesson](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5c1a1373b1&e=7017cc100e) and has repeatedly said[ he is against abortion in all forms](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=fe1f3f51c8&e=7017cc100e). That’s why Orange County’s women in leadership support Dave Min for congress.
_"Dave Min is a proven leader who will fight tirelessly for Orange County families in Congress. His record of championing critical legislation, from protecting reproductive rights to addressing gun violence, demonstrates his unwavering commitment to our community. With Dave, we have a dedicated advocate who will work tirelessly to advance our shared values and priorities. I proudly endorse Dave Min for Congress because I know he will always put the needs of Orange County first." _ **\- Assemblymember Cottie Petrie-Norris**

_“I endorse Dave Min for Congress. In the Senate, Dave championed reproductive freedom, enacted common sense gun legislation, fought to prevent new offshore oil drilling, and brought home tens of millions of tax dollars for wildfire prevention and new community parks. I look forward to partnering with Dave Min as our next Congressmember for all Orange County families.”_ **\- Supervisor Katrina Foley**

_"I endorse my friend Dave Min... I know how much Dave cares about our country and Orange County. During the financial crisis, Dave fought to hold Wall Street accountable and to help stabilize our economy. I’ve been impressed with his record in the California State Senate, where he has been a progressive leader on issues like gun violence prevention, reproductive rights, and environmental protection. He ended gun shows on California state property, has fought to end offshore oil drilling, passed critical protections for domestic violence survivors, and delivered billions of dollars in COVID-19 relief funds to small businesses. State Senator Dave Min will be a fantastic member of Congress...”_ **\- Congresswoman Katie Porter**
Min’s impressive coalition of support also includes **Costa Mesa Councilwoman Andrea Marr, Huntington Beach Councilwoman Rhonda Bolton, Huntington Beach Councilwoman Natalie Moser, Former Huntington Beach Mayor Kim Carr, Irvine Vice-Mayor Tammy Kim, and Irvine Councilwoman Kathleen Treseder** , among many others.

In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, California Governor Gavin Newsom, and over 50 local elected officials. He is also the consensus choice of Teachers, Police, Firefighters, and Organized Labor, with major endorsements including the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, the Fraternal Order of Police, the Police Officers Research Association of California, the International Association of Firefighters, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=8266685c74&e=7017cc100e).
###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2bfbf29344&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

name: Phil Izon
subject: “It’s a David and Goliath story,” referring to the biblical tale…
body:
Please share this with as many people as you can. Share with 5-10 people. | | | **Phil Izon’s Newsletter**
---
| [_ _ Donate Today to Continue Our Nationwide Education Efforts _ _](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67097c80d46220457e713fc3&u=https%3A%2F%2Frankedchoiceedu.org%2Fcheckout%2Fdonate%3FdonatePageId%3D63be1c6bafeaaa06bd4c3914&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67097846ee42881f6068e923&l=en-US&s=U8hfAdFDWL-JXbFK3aD1UH5f9TM%3D)
---
**Phillip Izon II, whose campaign to repeal the state’s open primary and ranked voice voting system raised only $120,000, said he is still confident that Ballot Measure 2 will prevail on Election Day. He spoke with the Alaska Beacon from Hawaii, where he is taking a monthslong break after signature gathering and fighting the lawsuits that have dogged him since he organized to roll back the state’s new voting system.****“It’s a David and Goliath story,” he said by phone on Tuesday, referring to the biblical tale wherein a young shepherd takes on a Philistine giant and prevails.****He may be outraised by 100-to-1, but Izon said the repeal effort has excitement on its side. He pointed to huge turnouts at events he promoted through radio ads and social media and the signature gathering effort that he said was led by more than 400 volunteers.****The vast majority of the $12 million raised by the pro ranked choice group No on 2 came from out of state. Its top three contributors are nonpartisan advocacy non-profits from the Lower 48: Article IV, in Arlington, Virginia; Unite America, in Denver, Colorado; and Action Now Initiative LLC, in Houston, Texas.****...No on 2 has spent money on radio and TV advertising as well as mailed advertising materials, polling and events. Izon criticized them for focusing on the issue of the open primary rather than mentioning ranked choice voting.****...Izon’s repeal campaign brought in smaller donations that are mostly from Alaskans. He criticized the opposition’s big, out-of-state donors and said he knew from the start that he wouldn’t be able to compete on fundraising.****But Izon said he doesn’t think the pro ranked choice campaign’s ads or its millions will matter in the end.****“I don’t think they’ll be able to spend enough,” he said.**[**Click Here to Read Article**](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67097c80d46220457e713fc3&u=https%3A%2F%2Falaskabeacon.com%2Fbriefs%2Falaska-ranked-choice-voting-repeal-effort-outraised-a-hundredfold-campaign-finance-filings-show%2F&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67097846ee42881f6068e923&l=en-US&s=NL1vwIYpq8mDmvsy9yFkrqxL3gU%3D)
---
**Though Izon’s focus is ranked choice voting, he said the open primary is worth repealing because it is susceptible to manipulation.****“Anybody can finance a candidate to get on the ballot and get into the top four, and then tell them to drop out,” he said, adding that the idea should scare people from any political party. He pointed to the case of Eric Hafner, the imprisoned out-of-state Democrat who is on the U.S. House ballot after a legal challenge failed. “There’s a sizable chunk of the population that don’t even know Eric Hafner is in prison,” Izon said.****He said there are multiple examples of spoiler candidates in this year’s election, so he would rather political parties vet candidates than deal with that.****“Would you rather vote a straight ticket or have a criminal on your ballot in a general [election]?” he asked. “Personally, I would rather vote a straight ticket.”****The main argument of many opponents of ranked choice voting is that ranking candidates is too confusing for voters. Izon said he thinks that confusion is behind a low turnout in Alaska’s 2022 general election. He said it was his grandfather’s bafflement when confronted with a ranked choice ballot that compelled him to begin the recall in the first place.****...Izon reflected that in fighting one confusing change, he may be precipitating another. But he said he is driven to find the most fair voting system.****“Every time we make a change, we’re hurting someone, and that’s the problem. What is the most fair system right now? I think the most fair system is the system that everyone understands,” he said.**[**Click Here To Read Article**](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67097c80d46220457e713fc3&u=https%3A%2F%2Falaskabeacon.com%2F2024%2F10%2F11%2Fwhat-alaska-voters-should-know-as-they-consider-a-repeal-of-open-primaries-and-ranked-choice-voting%2F&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67097846ee42881f6068e923&l=en-US&s=gPXnRLuAHFIn0jNYU8Kqe9I1d3g%3D)
---

Share with 5-10 people. | | | Phil Izon’s Newsletter | Phillip Izon II, whose campaign to repeal the state’s open primary and ranked voice voting system raised only $120,000, said he is still confident that Ballot Measure 2 will prevail on Election Day. He spoke with the Alaska Beacon from Hawaii, where he is taking a monthslong break after signature gathering and fighting the lawsuits that have dogged him since he organized to roll back the state’s new voting system.“It’s a David and Goliath story,” he said by phone on Tuesday, referring to the biblical tale wherein a young shepherd takes on a Philistine giant and prevails.He may be outraised by 100-to-1, but Izon said the repeal effort has excitement on its side. He pointed to huge turnouts at events he promoted through radio ads and social media and the signature gathering effort that he said was led by more than 400 volunteers.The vast majority of the $12 million raised by the pro ranked choice group No on 2 came from out of state. Its top three contributors are nonpartisan advocacy non-profits from the Lower 48: Article IV, in Arlington, Virginia; Unite America, in Denver, Colorado; and Action Now Initiative LLC, in Houston, Texas....No on 2 has spent money on radio and TV advertising as well as mailed advertising materials, polling and events. Izon criticized them for focusing on the issue of the open primary rather than mentioning ranked choice voting....Izon’s repeal campaign brought in smaller donations that are mostly from Alaskans. He criticized the opposition’s big, out-of-state donors and said he knew from the start that he wouldn’t be able to compete on fundraising.But Izon said he doesn’t think the pro ranked choice campaign’s ads or its millions will matter in the end.“I don’t think they’ll be able to spend enough,” he said. Though Izon’s focus is ranked choice voting, he said the open primary is worth repealing because it is susceptible to manipulation.“Anybody can finance a candidate to get on the ballot and get into the top four, and then tell them to drop out,” he said, adding that the idea should scare people from any political party. He pointed to the case of Eric Hafner, the imprisoned out-of-state Democrat who is on the U.S. House ballot after a legal challenge failed. “There’s a sizable chunk of the population that don’t even know Eric Hafner is in prison,” Izon said.He said there are multiple examples of spoiler candidates in this year’s election, so he would rather political parties vet candidates than deal with that.“Would you rather vote a straight ticket or have a criminal on your ballot in a general [election]?” he asked. “Personally, I would rather vote a straight ticket.”The main argument of many opponents of ranked choice voting is that ranking candidates is too confusing for voters. Izon said he thinks that confusion is behind a low turnout in Alaska’s 2022 general election. He said it was his grandfather’s bafflement when confronted with a ranked choice ballot that compelled him to begin the recall in the first place....Izon reflected that in fighting one confusing change, he may be precipitating another. But he said he is driven to find the most fair voting system.“Every time we make a change, we’re hurting someone, and that’s the problem. What is the most fair system right now? clean_body: I am proud to have earned the endorsement of the Committee to Protect Health Care. | | | | I am proud to have earned the endorsement of the Committee to Protect Health Care —a coalition of 20,000+ doctors and advocates fighting to expand health care access, lower costs for patients, and protect reproductive rights. = Everyone has a right to universal, affordable health care coverage. In this Congress, I voted to reduce prescription drug costs: by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices; by imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation; and by capping the price of insulin at $35 per month for Medicare enrollees. I also voted to reduce premiums for 9 million Americans who buy insurance through the Affordable Care Act Marketplace. I have long been committed to supporting care for our seniors and to strengthening Social Security and Medicare. I voted to close a longstanding coverage gap in Medicaid that locks out 4 million people nationwide, to expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits, and to lower out-of-pocket costs for Medicare Part D beneficiaries. There is more work to be done to make health care affordable and accessible - and I will continue to fight that fight. clean_body: If you ask me, he’s EXACTLY the kind of leader and voice we need in the House. | Fellow American, California may produce some of the most left-wing politicians in the country, such as Kamala Harris. But ironically, it’s also once again our key to a Republican House majority. Kevin Lincoln is running in a battleground House race in CA-9 that presents one of our best opportunities to flip a Democrat-held seat in a deep blue state. Kevin and I have a lot in common: He’s a minority He’s a military veteran He loves God and is a family man He’s proven he can win in Democrat terrority If you ask me, he’s EXACTLY the kind of leader and voice we need in the House. His Democrat incumbent opponent voted 100% in favor of Bidenomics, he’s opposed efforts to secure our borders, and he pedals the woke agenda. Most importantly, his opponent is vulnerable , and this is a chance to have one less radical leftist in Washington working to destroy our country. Kevin is the real deal, and he has what it takes to win. I want Kevin Lincoln fighting alongside me in the House. For America, John James | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton. Like , Follow , and Subscribe! | | Recently, I wrote to you about the Republican Party's latest plan to further pack the Supreme Court with two potential vacancies if Donald Trump is re-elected president this November. We're all painfully aware of how politicized our nation's judicial system has become. What was once a forum for thoughtful debate and decisions based on precedent, science, and the rule of law has descended into a political arm of the Republican Party, thanks to the far-right judges and justices chosen by Trump and his buddies in order to legislate from the bench and strip the American people of their fundamental freedoms. It's high time to reform the highest court in the land, which is why I've introduced comprehensive and sweeping legislation to overhaul our nation's judiciary, and restore much-needed confidence in our country's legal system. My bill would bring much-needed reform to our nation's judicial system in a number of ways. Here are a few essential components – for both the Supreme Court and lower courts across the country:
* **Expand the Supreme Court from 9 to 15 over the course of 12 years.** The staggered timeline would ensure that the additional justices are chosen by potentially three different presidential administrations, not just one.

* **Establish a new process for Supreme Court nominations** that are not reported out of Senate committee within 180 calendar days to be automatically placed on the Senate calendar. This would help ensure that we avoid what happened with Merrick Garland's nomination under President Obama.

* **Increase the number of circuit courts to 15** and return to the practice of assigning one Supreme Court justice to oversee each circuit.

* **Expand the number of Circuit Court and District Court judgeships** to improve access to justice.

While we are all laser-focused on pushing back against Donald Trump's extremism this November, I'm not losing sight of something equally important: **protecting our courts from the likes of Donald Trump or any other future wannabe dictator who wants to hijack our legal system to rip away our constitutional rights.** The stakes have never been higher in a presidential election. But this is another example of why we need to elect progressive Democratic leaders up and down the ballot so we can pass ironclad laws into place that will protect the rights of the American people, not undermine them. I'm going to continue working as hard as I can in Washington to make this legislation the law of the land. clean_body: | | | | Recently, I wrote to you about the Republican Party's latest plan to further pack the Supreme Court with two potential vacancies if Donald Trump is re-elected president this November. We're all painfully aware of how politicized our nation's judicial system has become. What was once a forum for thoughtful debate and decisions based on precedent, science, and the rule of law has descended into a political arm of the Republican Party, thanks to the far-right judges and justices chosen by Trump and his buddies in order to legislate from the bench and strip the American people of their fundamental freedoms. It's high time to reform the highest court in the land, which is why I've introduced comprehensive and sweeping legislation to overhaul our nation's judiciary, and restore much-needed confidence in our country's legal system. My bill would bring much-needed reform to our nation's judicial system in a number of ways. Here are a few essential components – for both the Supreme Court and lower courts across the country: Expand the Supreme Court from 9 to 15 over the course of 12 years. The staggered timeline would ensure that the additional justices are chosen by potentially three different presidential administrations, not just one. Establish a new process for Supreme Court nominations that are not reported out of Senate committee within 180 calendar days to be automatically placed on the Senate calendar. This would help ensure that we avoid what happened with Merrick Garland's nomination under President Obama. Increase the number of circuit courts to 15 and return to the practice of assigning one Supreme Court justice to oversee each circuit. Expand the number of Circuit Court and District Court judgeships to improve access to justice. While we are all laser-focused on pushing back against Donald Trump's extremism this November, I'm not losing sight of something equally important: protecting our courts from the likes of Donald Trump or any other future wannabe dictator who wants to hijack our legal system to rip away our constitutional rights. The stakes have never been higher in a presidential election. But this is another example of why we need to elect progressive Democratic leaders up and down the ballot so we can pass ironclad laws into place that will protect the rights of the American people, not undermine them. I'm going to continue working as hard as I can in Washington to make this legislation the law of the land. I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban.

He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him.

Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith.

He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan.

And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat.

Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way.

Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation - and for that matter so was I.

He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith.

Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability.

I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader.

clean_body: | | | | | America gave him a Purple Heart and I gave him my whole heart. | "Sam Brown" I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation - and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader. | | Friends, you’ve probably heard the term “battleground state” or maybe even “swing state” a few times this election season — we’ve used it in our emails to describe how Georgia will play a role in this year’s elections. A battleground or swing state means the votes in that state could be won by either candidate, helping them get closer to 270 electoral votes. In the 2024 presidential election, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Arizona, and North Carolina are key battleground states. We know President Joe Biden won our state by just under 12,000 votes in 2020 — which triggered MAGA extremists to lie about voter fraud and set off their plan to block access to the ballot box. Georgia has been on the frontline of voter suppression attacks since. Polling shows Georgia in a statistical tie between Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump, meaning our votes will be pivotal to the final results of the election. This is why our work is so important, friends. Through your support, our voter programs and educational resources play a role in building voter power in Georgia. Illegal immigration poses a significant threat to the sovereignty, security, and fiscal health of the United States--and Idaho is no exception. As a state that values tradition, law, and order, Idaho must take decisive action to deter illegal immigration and protect its future.
Which begs the question - _**what can we actually do about it at a local and state level?**_
## The Fiscal Burden of Illegal Immigration
Illegal immigrants are a net fiscal drain on our country and, by extension, on Idaho. Because they consume more in public services--such as healthcare, education, and welfare--than they contribute in taxes.
[According to the Manhattan Institute](https://substack.com/redirect/3b61a772-7be4-4ba3-8f55-aad8c864486d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the current federal policies under the Biden administration, taxpayers are projected to be on the hook for at least **$1.15 trillion** to support illegal immigrants. That's more than the entire defense budget or our annual Social Security spending.
This unsustainable burden threatens the financial well-being of our state and its residents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/655ffbe7-fe09-4927-b7c1-8d03cc963f5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source:_[Welfare Use by Immigrants and the U.S.-Born](https://substack.com/redirect/8047d624-ab51-454c-bbfa-01dc5ddde958?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
## The Security Risks of Open Borders
An open border is an open invitation to chaos.
**It's not just about people "seeking better opportunities;" it's about
the influx of crime, drugs, human trafficking, and terrorists.**
More crime, more trafficking, more drugs, more weapons, and more terrorists in Idaho. That's what's on the menu. This undermines the safety and stability of Idaho communities, causing crime, death, and destruction that could have been prevented by simply following the existing law.
_And even though Biden doesn 't act like it, we're a nation built on laws, not selective compliance. _
Picture the chaos on the streets if everyone decided to follow traffic laws only when convenient. Allowing illegal immigrants to thumb their noses at our laws erodes the very foundation of our society and sets a dangerous precedent for lawlessness.
The Supreme Court acknowledges that the federal government _**" has broad, undoubted power over the subject of immigration and the status of aliens"**_[1](https://substack.com/redirect/664ea1ae-26d1-447e-ad25-6c1951c4d83d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Yet, Biden and the Uniparty have failed to enforce these laws, leaving states to bear the brunt of the consequences. for example, [here's just one recent story about how Biden's illegal, treasonous open border policy is affecting Idaho](https://substack.com/redirect/77b5dc87-c167-425c-9dfe-4d851fe4ea2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This dereliction of duty by the federal government is unacceptable. If Washington won't act to protect our borders and enforce our laws, then Idaho must step up to safeguard our state.
## Action Plan for Idaho
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9556330a-22bf-41b2-acc6-4f2f8e606c30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### 1\. Enforce Employer Accountability with E-Verify
We must hold businesses that hire illegal immigrants accountable. Requiring all employers to use the E-Verify system will ensure that only legal residents are employed. **E-Verify** "can determine with great accuracy the authenticity of the personal information and credentials offered by new hires. In most cases, verification occurs almost instantly."[2](https://substack.com/redirect/dadc13e4-79f5-4017-9b80-7452e3004bb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This system effectively deters the employment of illegal immigrants by eliminating the "jobs magnet" that draws them here in the first place.
Arizona set a precedent in 2007 by passing a law that mandates employers to use E-Verify[3](https://substack.com/redirect/5c4549f9-f53e-4ff2-b43d-7e03465329d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Supreme Court upheld this law, and several other states have followed suit. It's time for Idaho to join them.
### 2\. Impose Strict Penalties on Employers of Illegal Immigrants
Businesses that knowingly hire illegal aliens are complicit in undermining our laws. They often feign ignorance, claiming, _" As far as I know, they are here legally,"_ but we all know better. Channel 7 even did a story with folks openly admitting they knowingly hire illegals[4](https://substack.com/redirect/4737af60-6061-4b40-8590-8df3dfe62adb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
These employers should face severe consequences, such as the revocation or suspension of their business licenses. The Supreme Court supports this approach, stating that federal law _" expressly reserves to the States the authority to impose sanctions on employers hiring unauthorized workers, through licensing and similar laws"_[5](https://substack.com/redirect/95b262b7-da6e-45df-9d79-210c4eb78a51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### 3\. Eliminate Loopholes for Day Laborers
Idaho should adopt measures similar to Arizona's **[Support Our Law Enforcement and Safe Neighborhoods Act (SB 1070)](https://substack.com/redirect/55fc7033-9219-41a0-b390-c62dda12234d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , which makes it essentially illegal for illegal "day laborers" to be picked up and hired without proper documentation. This reduces the opportunities for illegal immigrants to find work and discourages them from settling in our state.
### 4\. Crack Down on Sanctuary Cities and Counties
While Idaho has made progress with **[SB 1030](https://substack.com/redirect/9aa5b0d4-0936-4117-bf87-a8ce33756954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ in 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/9aa5b0d4-0936-4117-bf87-a8ce33756954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), declaring sanctuary cities illegal, we must go further. The law needs TEETH. Any city or county that attempts to subvert federal immigration law should face significant penalties. We cannot allow pockets of lawlessness within our state.
### 5\. Empower Law Enforcement Officers
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae04d7cb-f355-4dc9-bf58-ff72b145876a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our law enforcement officers should have the authority to determine the legal status of individuals they encounter during lawful stops when there is reasonable suspicion of illegal status. This isn't about racial profiling; it's about giving officers the tools they need to enforce the law effectively.
#### **Participate Fully in the 287(g) Program**
Idaho must require all local law enforcement agencies to participate in the **287(g) program** , which "deputizes" local officers to work with ICE and enforce federal immigration laws. Kootenai County Sheriff Bob Norris has already committed to this [on a recent X space](https://substack.com/redirect/95cf8dbe-5e51-4c8a-bf45-96ebfc724b27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). However, currently, only two counties in Idaho participate (Gooding and Power)[6](https://substack.com/redirect/f4ae4f4c-db83-415f-b5b6-0d7227be58da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Expanding this statewide would significantly enhance our ability to enforce immigration laws at the local level.
### 6\. Criminalize Harboring & Transporting Illegal Immigrants
Idaho should make it a crime to hide, lure, or transport illegal aliens. This would deter individuals and organizations from facilitating illegal immigration and help to root out networks that enable this unlawful activity.
### 7\. Deny Licenses and Identification to Illegal Immigrants
Efforts to roll out the red carpet by doing things like giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants, [such as those continually proposed by Idaho State Senator Jim Guthrie](https://substack.com/redirect/83d68534-b5d3-40c5-9298-8d105a294b62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), are misguided.
Instead, we should go the other way and make it illegal to issue driver's licenses, vehicle registrations, or any official documentation to those who are in our country unlawfully. Providing these documents only enables illegal immigrants to embed themselves deeper into our society.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/528d7b21-e88e-47e6-a5ef-f4a4b8e9d4f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### Closing Thoughts...
This isn't about xenophobia, skin pigmentation, or intolerance...
_This is about preserving the rule of law, protecting our communities, and ensuring the future prosperity of Idaho._
By making it _exceedingly difficult_ for illegal immigrants to live and function in our state, and by imposing heavy consequences on those who enable them, we send a clear message: **Idaho stands for law and order.**
If the federal government refuses to enforce immigration laws, then Idaho must take matters into its own hands. Our state's sovereignty, security, and prosperity depend on it.

Voting in the 2024 Election is happening right now.
Vote-by-mail ballots were sent to eligible voters in California this week, and early voting sites opened as well.
Every single day that passes, more people are voting and there are less persuadable voters we can reach and convince to vote Democratic.
That’s why this weekend we are holding a *MASSIVE* Weekend of Action to reach undecided voters in the ultra-competitive swing seats that will determine control of the U.S. House. If you think the election hasn’t already begun — you’re wrong! Over _4 million ballots_ have already been cast (including in all 7 key battleground states)! Voters are showing up because they know this election is one we cannot afford to miss. **[I need your help so JanePAC can reach climate voters before they go to the polls. Can you chip in today to power my organization’s efforts?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94834894/504694665/2105508926?refcode=ea.13b81e29-0c88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.13b81e29-0c88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEzYjgxZTI5LTBjODgtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ic8S6FdRpugEOxwJ-af2U2lfr_MPgt8GuXN4d4OMI5M=)** Now, I know the enormity of the climate crisis has a way of making us feel powerless. It’s easy to wonder, “Does my vote even matter?” But trust me, it does. Imagine small streams coming together to form a powerful river. Alone, one vote might seem like a drop in a bucket, but together, we create a force strong enough to shape the future. The fossil fuel industry and its allies are betting that we’ll stay home — that we’ll give in to hopelessness. But they underestimate us. We know that this election could be our last chance to create a livable future for our children, our grandchildren, and our communities. My team and I are working around the clock from now until November 5th to mobilize voters and elect climate champions across the country _(And I mean it. I am personally knocking doors every chance I get)._ It’s hard work, but fulfilling work... it helps that our JanePAC-endorsed climate champions are so inspiring this year! **[So, I’m asking: Will you chip in today to power our mission? It’s easy to wonder, “Does my vote even matter?” But trust me, it does. Imagine small streams coming together to form a powerful river. Alone, one vote might seem like a drop in a bucket, but together, we create a force strong enough to shape the future. The fossil fuel industry and its allies are betting that we’ll stay home — that we’ll give in to hopelessness. But they underestimate us. We know that this election could be our last chance to create a livable future for our children, our grandchildren, and our communities. My team and I are working around the clock from now until November 5th to mobilize voters and elect climate champions across the country (And I mean it. | **The only way to get a new Senator for New Mexico is to get out and vote.** It’s time to fire Martin Heinrich! [Absentee and limited early voting](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=fc62bb81ff&e=780129cd82) started this week! Beginning October 19th, you’ll be able to [vote at several locations](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=08c5a4fbdb&e=780129cd82) throughout your county.

U.S. Senator Martin Heinrich launched a new ad today in an apparent attempt to defend his poor record on Fentanyl and border security. His new attempt to muddy his record comes after his opponent, Nella Domenici, launched ads weeks ago pointing out his horrible record and failures as New Mexico’s senior senator.

_**Mike Braun’s Public Safety Plan!**_
---
---
Below are highlights from the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda - For Ensuring Hoosier' Safety.
---
**1) Confront the Drug Crisis**
* Hoosier families have been devastated by the flow of illegal drugs like fentanyl and methamphetamine into their communities. In addition to harming our families, drug-related incidents have overrun the State’s public health and safety resources.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** prioritize a collaborative drug interdiction approach that fully utilizes the expertise and resources of the Indiana State Police and local law enforcement and prosecutors.

**2) Enforce our Laws**
* Our law enforcement officers put their life on the line every day to protect Hoosiers. After our officers make arrests, prosecutors are best-equipped to enforce the law when they have the resources they need to hire high-quality deputies, and when the bail system works to keep dangerous criminals off the street.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** ensure Indiana’s criminal justice system supports the work of our law enforcement efforts and make sure our prosecutors are equipped to enforce the law to the fullest.

**3) Tackle illegal immigration**
* Under the Biden-Harris Administration, enforcement at the southern border has deteriorated, empowering an overwhelming number of illegal immigrants to cross into the country.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** provide the support necessary to communities struggling with illegal immigration by ensuring Indiana has no sanctuary policies and stand ready to assist if and when the federal government seeks assistance in safeguarding Hoosiers.

**4) Support our Police**
* Every day, our law enforcement officers put their lives on the line to protect Hoosiers.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** champion policies that enhance training, benefits, and salaries to improve morale, retention, and recruitment of law enforcement officers across the state.

**5) Treat Mental Health with Seriousness**
* Hoosiers are encountering a mental health crisis that not only impacts their loved ones, but also strains public safety resources that now serve as _de facto_ treatment centers for those in need.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** invest in local treatment facilities so that those in mental crisis receive the care they need without placing an added burden on law enforcement and the criminal justice system.

**6) Prioritize school safety**
* Currently, Indiana’s school safety authorities are fragmented across different agencies. As modern threats continue to grow in complexity, the State must ensure that local communities and schools are supported so that no aspect of school safety falls through the cracks.

* **Mike Braun's plan will** establish the Office of School Safety to streamline resources that are spread across many agencies and ensure that every school is able to protect our children.

---
**Mike Braun issued the following statement upon releasing his plan to ensure Hoosiers' Safety:** _**“Every Hoosier deserves to feel safe in their community, and to achieve that we need to support our police with the training and resources they need, confront the drug crisis head on, enforce the law so criminals don’t end up back on the street due to prosecutors refusing to do their jobs, tackle illegal immigration bringing fentanyl and crime to our streets like the attack we saw on a young girl in northwest Indiana, and take action to give our schools what they need to keep kids safe.” – Mike Braun**_

Below are highlights from the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda - For Ensuring Hoosier' Safety. 1) Confront the Drug Crisis Hoosier families have been devastated by the flow of illegal drugs like fentanyl and methamphetamine into their communities. In addition to harming our families, drug-related incidents have overrun the State’s public health and safety resources. Mike Braun's plan will prioritize a collaborative drug interdiction approach that fully utilizes the expertise and resources of the Indiana State Police and local law enforcement and prosecutors. 2) Enforce our Laws Our law enforcement officers put their life on the line every day to protect Hoosiers. After our officers make arrests, prosecutors are best-equipped to enforce the law when they have the resources they need to hire high-quality deputies, and when the bail system works to keep dangerous criminals off the street. Mike Braun's plan will ensure Indiana’s criminal justice system supports the work of our law enforcement efforts and make sure our prosecutors are equipped to enforce the law to the fullest. 3) Tackle illegal immigration Under the Biden-Harris Administration, enforcement at the southern border has deteriorated, empowering an overwhelming number of illegal immigrants to cross into the country. Mike Braun's plan will provide the support necessary to communities struggling with illegal immigration by ensuring Indiana has no sanctuary policies and stand ready to assist if and when the federal government seeks assistance in safeguarding Hoosiers. 4) Support our Police Every day, our law enforcement officers put their lives on the line to protect Hoosiers. Mike Braun's plan will champion policies that enhance training, benefits, and salaries to improve morale, retention, and recruitment of law enforcement officers across the state. 5) Treat Mental Health with Seriousness Hoosiers are encountering a mental health crisis that not only impacts their loved ones, but also strains public safety resources that now serve as de facto treatment centers for those in need. Mike Braun's plan will invest in local treatment facilities so that those in mental crisis receive the care they need without placing an added burden on law enforcement and the criminal justice system. 6) Prioritize school safety Currently, Indiana’s school safety authorities are fragmented across different agencies. As modern threats continue to grow in complexity, the State must ensure that local communities and schools are supported so that no aspect of school safety falls through the cracks. Mike Braun's plan will establish the Office of School Safety to streamline resources that are spread across many agencies and ensure that every school is able to protect our children. Mike Braun issued the following statement upon releasing his plan to ensure Hoosiers' Safety: “Every Hoosier deserves to feel safe in their community, and to achieve that we need to support our police with the training and resources they need, confront the drug crisis head on, enforce the law so criminals don’t end up back on the street due to prosecutors refusing to do their jobs, tackle illegal immigration bringing fentanyl and crime to our streets like the attack we saw on a young girl in northwest Indiana, and take action to give our schools what they need to keep kids safe.” – Mike Braun | Super Saturday Upcoming Schedule | | 📱 News You Can Use Governor Eric Holcomb approximately 400 National Guardsman to aid in hurricane relief efforts. Hi Peter,
There are only four weekends left until final votes are cast in November’s presidential race. Four weekends to get out the vote to elect care champions Kamala Harris and Tim Walz – and to stop Donald Trump and J.D. Vance from getting to the White House.
On the heels of Vice President Kamala Harris’ announced proposal to allow Medicare to cover in-home care services, Kamala and Tim are traveling the country getting their message out. But it’s up to us to make sure every last voter knows what’s at stake for women of color, care workers, and working families in this election.
**This race is going to come down to the wire, so it’s critical that we use our voices to speak with voters this weekend. Here are a few ways to get involved – sign up today: **
1. [**Join a nationwide virtual Women for Harriz-Walz phone bank.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94835993/504698547/-156969780?ms=101124_CiA_VolunteerforHarris&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=c4e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJhNmQ5My0wZjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00ljD2B9ZQod5eQs1KJQwKSeoi-lw0VhcjZjeRq5veQ=&emci=556d991d-0188-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=602a6d93-0f88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

2. **If you’re in Philadelphia, **[**join Saturday's Women for Harris Care Economy Roundtable and Canvass Kickoff with Care in Action senior advisor Ai-jen Poo,**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94835995/504698553/521661072?ms=101124_CiA_VolunteerforHarris&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=c4e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJhNmQ5My0wZjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00ljD2B9ZQod5eQs1KJQwKSeoi-lw0VhcjZjeRq5veQ=&emci=556d991d-0188-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=602a6d93-0f88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)** or **[**sign up for a canvass shift in Germantown with the Pennsylvania Democrats.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94835996/504698555/-2084955538?ms=101124_CiA_VolunteerforHarris&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=c4e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJhNmQ5My0wZjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00ljD2B9ZQod5eQs1KJQwKSeoi-lw0VhcjZjeRq5veQ=&emci=556d991d-0188-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=602a6d93-0f88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94835998/504698556/843558817?ms=101124_CiA_VolunteerforHarris&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=c4e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJhNmQ5My0wZjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00ljD2B9ZQod5eQs1KJQwKSeoi-lw0VhcjZjeRq5veQ=&emci=556d991d-0188-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=602a6d93-0f88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
In a major announcement this week, [Kamala Harris unveiled her “Medicare for Home” proposal](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94836000/504698558/-1225514714?ms=101124_CiA_VolunteerforHarris&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=c4e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJhNmQ5My0wZjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00ljD2B9ZQod5eQs1KJQwKSeoi-lw0VhcjZjeRq5veQ=&emci=556d991d-0188-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=602a6d93-0f88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787) – a plan that would take a huge financial and emotional weight off of workers and families by covering long term care at home through Medicare.
Vice President Harris is focused on strengthening and expanding Medicare. Donald Trump has tried to cut Medicare in every single one of his budgets, has called for raising the retirement age to 70, and his Project 2025 plan would raise families’ costs by $4,000 a year. **We need to make sure voters know about these starkly different visions for the future, and then get out to vote for real solutions for working families. **
[**Join us and sign up to reach out to voters with the Harris-Walz campaign this weekend.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94836002/504698560/2136787208?ms=101124_CiA_VolunteerforHarris&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=c4e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDJhNmQ5My0wZjg4LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00ljD2B9ZQod5eQs1KJQwKSeoi-lw0VhcjZjeRq5veQ=&emci=556d991d-0188-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=602a6d93-0f88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
Let’s go!
The Care in Action Team

body:
I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.

| Hi Peter — I have a personal story I’d like to share with you.

Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.

When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, wanted to make sure I was protected in case I got sick again. But they couldn’t find any insurance policies that would cover me in the future.

_Not from any insurer. Not at any price._

That meant my grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket, and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition.

I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried that I might fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care.

No one should ever have to go through that. But my story is not unique, Peter, and I knew they weren’t the only ones. **That’s why I got into public service.**

I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.

Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. And when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, _almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance._

So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care and threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — **including my opponent Eric Hovde, who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.”**

If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies are putting profits over people.

That’s not right. And that’s why I need your help to defeat him.

[_**I’ve fought against Republicans’ efforts to repeal the ACA before, and I won’t back down now.
