clean_body: Please read this full message Peter, At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record. And what's worse, they are doing it all because I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate. Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT. Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end. I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania. I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor. Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement. I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it. I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record. I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it! Here's where I need your help, Peter. We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me. The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. Chuck Schumer and his allies are working overtime to obliterate my campaign. They have committed to spend whatever it takes to defeat me. They know if I win this race in Pennsylvania, it 'll be IMPOSSIBLE for Democrats to keep their majority in the Senate. If we don't show the Democrats we can win this race, it's game over. That’s why, as State Senator, Sarah rolled up her sleeves and brought people together to pass paid family and medical leave — and she delivered when no one thought she’d be able to get it done. _In Congress, she’ll stop at nothing to do the same._

subject: Here’s the bottom line

body:
#
Here’s the bottom line, Peter.

Hi friend — I hope I caught you before you logged off for the weekend. I understand the _last_ thing anyone wants to be doing after a long week is checking their inbox. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2044%2E135344%2El0DFAg)

Friend --
Sometimes it shocks me that anyone donates to fundraising emails from political campaigns.
If you're anything like me, you open your email in the morning and it's overflowing with emails from every Senate campaign, House campaign, the presidential campaign, party committees, and organizations you know and likely many you've never heard of. Most of the time I haven’t signed up for these lists.
I get why these emails happen: they are an increasingly important part of how campaigns and organizations are funded. Especially on the Democratic side. Our small dollar, online, and texting programs are light-years more productive than the GOP, and often account for a third of our monthly fundraising.
So in a sea of Democratic emails and texts, I do my best to differentiate our content, and edit every single one, including this one. The fact that you opened this email instead of deleting it and made it this far gives me hope there's a chance.
There is no winning the Senate without this race in Michigan. There is no winning the White House either. At the same time, this is going to be one of the most competitive (and expensive) races in the country. Poll after poll shows it razor tight.
Republicans know that too, that is why they'll put ridiculous amounts of money in to beat us. And since I don’t accept corporate PAC money, I have to rely on the generosity of individuals like you who understand the stakes of this race.
Hopefully that's a compelling case. It’s my job to make it. Because there's no winning this race without a significant response to emails like this by people like you.
[**Would you consider contributing $3 to my Senate campaign in Michigan to help me hold this seat, and the Senate, for Democrats in November? Peter,

The Senate is OURS to take. _I can feel it._

So can Chuck Schumer. Rumor is he is absolutely FREAKING OUT.

Democrats are in full-blown panic mode because they know what’s coming – Ohio is on the brink of flipping RED. Now, you might be thinking, _“Well, if Bernie has this in the bag, we can relax, right?”_

**WRONG.**

That’s exactly what Chuck Schumer and Sherrod Brown want us to do. They’re banking on us getting complacent so they can swoop in with their **$30 MILLION war chest** and steal this seat back at the last minute.

_We’re closer than ever, but this fight is far from over._

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=18d758a5542e44cc843a7bd3d08edbd4&_e=BdRFWG3pREQfuJc-k-yAgyQeuE0CmYZik4Q3obEPEhT34jy9mSgM1pz_e8W-VBKYPVYmwPKG8sUTsythM8-JeVT-QWhYVZRj3EwE2Mbhd7VTC54TZT8mUj_hjVmQbXgaks-isdZ-3E4rlf7Edrqb0xHwgW4Pzh_TqHxPy41k6JKpIs2j1oTIgRvYrXsVVJSY7T5yJDJPIy1ViU9pXHt8-1sCSmSKuNI4Sx9cTn6ivwuEY9eyBmHL3ANRrXT04gkZPQYT-LX48UmoBTQCtaCXLYhl2mdynbb8TOtM9oQxLBYJacUlTULD99Z_4ZdwcmQMktkdknyTIIBm6AynPsc3JxeNcriGMu6r-Q6aiv9xOaoy7MYRk3QwPRqj85tcC2yQkQ3M56UIBEyM5lUweKXgRA%3D%3D)

**Here’s the real reason why Schumer and company are panicking:** the radical Democrats led by Schumer and Sherrod have spent DECADES putting America LAST. You have to wonder if they actually take pleasure in pushing their disastrous agenda on the rest of us.

_They want another decade of putting America last._

Think about it – Schumer and Brown have spent their careers **rewarding sanctuary cities****, opening our borders,** and sending **billions of dollars** to countries that hate us. They care more about building someone else’s country than fixing ours. And now they want to make you pay for it — while Ohioans are struggling with **sky-high inflation, fentanyl pouring in,** and **violent crime** in our once quiet communities.

[**Pitch in $5 – the cost of a cup of coffee – or $50 – the cost of a tank of gas – to help us crush Sherrod Brown and Chuck Schumer and deliver on the America FIRST promise.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=18d758a5542e44cc843a7bd3d08edbd4&_e=BdRFWG3pREQfuJc-k-yAgyQeuE0CmYZik4Q3obEPEhT34jy9mSgM1pz_e8W-VBKYPVYmwPKG8sUTsythM8-JeVT-QWhYVZRj3EwE2Mbhd7VTC54TZT8mUj_hjVmQbXgaks-isdZ-3E4rlf7Edrqb0xHwgW4Pzh_TqHxPy41k6JKpIs2j1oTIgRvYrXsVVJSY7T5yJDJPIy1ViU9pXHt8-1sCSmSKuNI4Sx9cTn6ivwuEY9eyBmHL3ANRrXT04gkZCbQN5nlnaJvGWWQAdnNRIZ4n5CZang2zkySfxIKar-m_tuIV5jiQijDfvrOJB75qqnHsRfpM4dZs3JHl8hbrzK7JarsMuyUpZfwJuEbn0W_dVitUF1yDbsgRmUfBPE4IcVGjOQh9WZ-Q4dMqOR7_2w%3D%3D)

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=18d758a5542e44cc843a7bd3d08edbd4&_e=BdRFWG3pREQfuJc-k-yAgyQeuE0CmYZik4Q3obEPEhT34jy9mSgM1pz_e8W-VBKYPVYmwPKG8sUTsythM8-JeVT-QWhYVZRj3EwE2Mbhd7VTC54TZT8mUj_hjVmQbXgaks-isdZ-3E4rlf7Edrqb0xHwgW4Pzh_TqHxPy41k6JKpIs2j1oTIgRvYrXsVVJSY7T5yJDJPIy1ViU9pXHt8-1sCSmSKuNI4Sx9cTn6ivwuEY9eyBmHL3ANRrXT04gkZLh9LHQndxC1KInuzEl2P80mQeDH_UMyM-8PeulAXoAZx6yTBY_YBi3DHWhvbxp3zAEsSCTbnsRLSxFZPS60xpMsudYziDLy4A8n9EKJ0uLeQ5vnE4B-CUivbmg6VhSWkiaURqX0kBATvTWcUB-PMOg%3D%3D) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE asks NC court to act to prevent non-residents from voting in November election
body:
Court urged to take action before the upcoming election |
---
| |
---
| |
# **RITE Asks NC Court To Prevent Non-Residents from Voting in November Election**

Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today [asked a North Carolina court to act immediately](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=65c0d7ec03&e=ea91f782ea) to prevent people who have never lived in the state from voting in November’s election. Earlier this month, RITE [filed suit against the North Carolina State Board of Elections](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=1d7d4064ac&e=ea91f782ea) (“NCSBE”) to ensure that only eligible citizens can vote in state elections. Today, RITE asked the court to take action before the upcoming election.

Derek Lyons, RITE’s President and CEO, issued the following statement:

“North Carolina’s elections should be decided by North Carolina’s residents, not people living overseas who may have never even set foot in the state. North Carolina’s Constitution is clear on this point. Unfortunately, an obscure state statute purports to confer the right to vote on people born to Americans overseas who have never lived in the United States, let alone in North Carolina. This statute is unconstitutional, and these individuals do not have any right to participate in—let alone potentially decide—North Carolina’s elections. Ballots from these individuals should not be counted in the upcoming election or any future election.

Background: North Carolina’s Constitution specifically requires individuals to reside in the state in order to vote. However, a state statute directly conflicts with this requirement by permitting citizens born abroad to vote in North Carolina, even if they have never lived in the country, let alone the state. This statute is unconstitutional and its enforcement must be blocked so that only ballots cast by eligible resident citizens count in the state’s elections.

subject: My last newsletter before the election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chrissy Houlahan for Congress
body:
A NOTE FROM CHRISSY

Even though we’re only weeks away from another most-important-election-of-our-lifetime, I’m still busy serving as our community’s representative in Congress. In between house parties (thank you!), Zoom calls for Harris-Walz (please give!), and door knocking (please vote!), I am working for you. Here’s a quick update on what my team and I have been up to.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1058-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

MY 90TH and 91ST TOWN HALLS
In late September, I hosted my 90th town hall! This included an update on my work in Washington and Pennsylvania on behalf of our community before we turned to a discussion on nonpartisan voting resources. Please vote, everyone! If you have any questions about voting at all, please click here. My 91st town hall was last week and focused on Medicare resources. Every day my office gets at least one call from a constituent trying to sort out their benefits. We are here to help.

https://www.padems.org/vote-2/

FIRST PUBLIC HEARING OF THE TRUMP ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT TASK FORCE
Last month, I participated in the first hearing for the Trump Assassination Attempt Task Force. I used this time to talk to witnesses and identify the operational challenges and enormous gaps in communication at the two Secret Service command posts in Butler, and to ensure that something like this can never happen again. I'm happy to report that we're beginning to get the answers we need and that you deserve.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1058-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

MY LETTER TO POSTMASTER DEJOY
Since a fire caused the closure of the Airport Road Post Office in West Chester, I’ve heard from many in our community about how this is negatively impacting them. Because customers are being routed to other facilities, the wait times at the Gay Street post office are reaching 90 minutes. With ballots already in the mail, slower processing time and reduced resources are a serious concern. In response, I sent a letter to U.S. Postmaster DeJoy outlining my concerns and asking for immediate action on the most serious issues. I'll continue to advocate for my community until this is resolved.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1058-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

A FEW PHOTOS FROM THE BART-B-QUE
On a lighter note, I wanted to share a few photos from our annual Bart-B-Que, named in honor of my husband, Bart. If you were able to make it, I hope you had a blast!

Thank you for being a part of my team and making all of my work possible. As we head into November, I'll be sure to keep you updated and to continue advocating for you at every opportunity.

There's work to be done,
Chrissy

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1058-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

Chrissy is proud to be your voice in Congress and is committed to fighting for the value that matter in our community. But a divided Congress means there will be challenges ahead. We must all work together to have any chance of creating a better future that works for everyone.

So we're counting on the support of people like you to keep Chrissy's momentum going throughout the year. Can we count on you to join us and donate whatever you can spare right. now? Thank you for your support and for believing in our vision for a better future.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1058-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

I used this time to talk to witnesses and identify the operational challenges and enormous gaps in communication at the two Secret Service command posts in Butler, and to ensure that something like this can never happen again. I'm happy to report that we're beginning to get the answers we need and that you deserve. MY LETTER TO POSTMASTER DEJOY Since a fire caused the closure of the Airport Road Post Office in West Chester, I’ve heard from many in our community about how this is negatively impacting them. Because customers are being routed to other facilities, the wait times at the Gay Street post office are reaching 90 minutes. With ballots already in the mail, slower processing time and reduced resources are a serious concern. In response, I sent a letter to U.S. Postmaster DeJoy outlining my concerns and asking for immediate action on the most serious issues. I'll continue to advocate for my community until this is resolved. A FEW PHOTOS FROM THE BART-B-QUE On a lighter note, I wanted to share a few photos from our annual Bart-B-Que, named in honor of my husband, Bart. If you were able to make it, I hope you had a blast! Thank you for being a part of my team and making all of my work possible. As we head into November, I'll be sure to keep you updated and to continue advocating for you at every opportunity. There's work to be done, Chrissy Chrissy is proud to be your voice in Congress and is committed to fighting for the value that matter in our community. But a divided Congress means there will be challenges ahead. We must all work together to have any chance of creating a better future that works for everyone. So we're counting on the support of people like you to keep Chrissy's momentum going throughout the year. Can we count on you to join us and donate whatever you can spare right. now? Thank you for your support and for believing in our vision for a better future.

body:
The election starts much sooner than November 5.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241011-4390-footer&t=1&akid=4390%2E420207%2E73C5uk)
Can you believe it, Peter?
**Ballots drop in Washington in just ONE WEEK!** While a lot of people think about the election as happening on November 5, the reality is voters start casting their ballots _much_ sooner than that. Some states are voting already!
To mark this major milestone, we’ve set a goal of raising $2,500 in the next 24 hours. [**Will you pitch in $3 right now to help us reach our goal and support our GOTV efforts in these critical final weeks?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241011?refcode=em20241011&amount=3&refcode2=4390_420207_73C5uk&akid=4390%2E420207%2E73C5uk)
Once ballots are out, it’s an all hands on deck effort to contact as many people as possible and make sure they return it before the deadline.
In Washington, Pramila is encouraging folks to vote for Democrats up and down the ballot, including:
* **Kamala Harris** and **Tim Walz** for President and Vice President
* **Bob Ferguson** for Governor
* **Nick Brown** for Attorney General
* **Maria Cantwell** for Senate
* **Dave Upthegrove** for WA State Lands Commissioner
* She’s also encouraging people to **vote “NO”** on all four ballot initiatives.

There’s a lot riding on the outcome of this election, so we’re doing everything we can to make sure Democrats and progressives everywhere win. In addition to organizing for Pramila’s re-election here in Washington, we’re also working to turn out voters in swing states.
That’s because making sure Kamala Harris wins the White House — and making sure Democrats win in tough states and congressional districts that will determine control of the House and Senate — is a critical prerequisite to moving forward on any piece of progressive legislation.
[**Let’s get out there and make it happen, Peter. Will you pitch in $3 or anything you can to help us reach our $2,500 goal today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241011?refcode=em20241011&amount=3&refcode2=4390_420207_73C5uk&akid=4390%2E420207%2E73C5uk)

body:
Hurricane Milton has impacted millions of people. Here’s how you can help:
#
Hurricane Milton dumped as much as 16 inches of rain in parts of Florida with winds up to 120 mph, causing devastating flooding and threatening lives.
More than 3 million people have been without power since yesterday morning and entire communities are struggling to get food and water.
We’re asking you to join us in supporting **World Central Kitchen** , whose teams are working around the clock to **provide emergency food relief** in Florida.
[ Will you join us today and make a $5 contribution to help World Central Kitchen provide support to families who have been impacted by this deadly storm?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241011-wck.7NX4nu&refcode=em20241011-7375-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7375%2E2526796%2ElFUcqt)
_100% of your contribution will directly benefit World Central Kitchen._
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241011-wck.7NX4nu&refcode=em20241011-7375-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=7375%2E2526796%2ElFUcqt)**
Our hearts are with those who lost loved ones in the hurricane, and all those impacted.
Together, we will help this community make it out of this stronger.
Thank you,
Team AOC

name: The Democrats
subject: October 12-13
body:
We have significant voter contact goals this weekend and need your help to reach them.
---
Derek, October 12-13 is shaping up to be our biggest weekend of action yet. Early voting is underway in many states across the country, which means we need as many people as possible to join us to Get Out the Vote for Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats up and down the ticket. **This is how you can make an impact: sign up right now to talk to voters this weekend in Pennsylvania:**
* * *
**Knock Doors for Kamala Harris in Monroe County!** Saturday, October 12th, 9:00 a.m. Monroe County Office 24, Stroudsburg, PA 18360
[**SIGN UP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=645465.dT1fzf&refcode=em_20241011_1857_do&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241011_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241011_1857_do&t=1&akid=1857%2E22930333%2EFVFMke)**
* * *
**Kamala Harris Message Training in Stroudsburg** Sunday, October 13th, 2:00 p.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360
[**SIGN UP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=664203.H2LAzk&refcode=em_20241011_1857_do&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241011_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241011_1857_do&t=1&akid=1857%2E22930333%2EFVFMke)**
* * *
**Drive canvassers in Monroe County** Saturday, October 12th, 11:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360
[**SIGN UP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=705682.76_WoX&refcode=em_20241011_1857_do&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241011_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241011_1857_do&t=1&akid=1857%2E22930333%2EFVFMke)**
* * *
**[Can't make any of these events? Find many more opportunities to get involved in your community at go.kamalaharris.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/7835?t=2&akid=1857%2E22930333%2EFVFMke)** We have huge voter contact goals for this weekend. If everyone reading this email signed up right now, we’d reach them in no time. But the truth is a small percentage of folks who get this email will even read this far. **So if you’re able to contribute some time this weekend talking to voters, it will make a real difference, Derek. Especially in a place like Pennsylvania.** **[If you can’t make any of the events listed above, click here to find other upcoming events in your area. Any time you have to help get out the vote in Pennsylvania will help >>](https://ak.democrats.org/go/7835?t=5&akid=1857%2E22930333%2EFVFMke)** Thanks for all you do, The Democrats **[P.S. If you can also help by contributing $3 before our final FEC deadline early next week, it will go directly toward supporting our voter contact work on the ground in these final days.](https://ak.democrats.org/go/7837?amount=3&t=7&akid=1857%2E22930333%2EFVFMke)**

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

| | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. **I'll try to keep this brief.

My friends at the DSCC are doing everything they can to save our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority, and with just 25 days left before the election, every little bit helps. [So can I count on you to chip in $5 _(matched to become $15)_ to defend the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/20126?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241011-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241011-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&akid=18110%2E9716520%2ENYo9qB)**

As an activist, I know that **the greatest American victories of our time rarely came all at once.** They were the culmination of years or even decades of work, all with the goal of making our country a little more perfect -- one seemingly small act at a time.

But I also know there were many moments along the way when victory and defeat stood together on a knife's edge: A 5-4 decision in the Supreme Court, a tie-breaking vote in the Senate, an election decided by just a handful of votes.

Another such moment is before us in 25 days.

Will it yield a victory for Senate Democrats, who've fought fiercely to defend our rights and our democracy? Or defeat at the hands of Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans, who attack the legitimacy of our elections, raise taxes on hardworking Americans, and threaten the rights and freedoms we hold dear?

The experts say that enough races to decide Senate control are toss-ups. Now, we can pore over polls all day long, but I think the truth is a lot simpler: **You and I will decide what happens here. In these final weeks of the campaign, everything we do could make the difference. And that's why I'm asking for your help.**

**[Even $5 could be enough to keep the balance of the Senate in our favor. So please, chip in a matched gift of $5 _(becomes $15)_ to help defend our Democratic majority and keep our country moving forward >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/20126?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241011-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241011-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&akid=18110%2E9716520%2ENYo9qB)**

Peter,

Today is National Coming Out Day and in honor of this occasion, I want to be vulnerable with you for a moment and share my personal painful story about my coming out experience.

**In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay with bigoted and homophobic ads to our district. I hadn’t even come out publicly yet!**

For members of the LGBTQ+ community, coming out is an extremely personal and sensitive moment. So, you can imagine my horror and heartbreak upon finding out I had been outed so publicly in such a hateful way. I was crushed.

**I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012.**

Peter, I’m so glad that in the face of such discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up.

Now, I can fight for LGBTQ+ equality and dignity in our nation’s capital and stand up for other marginalized Americans.

But sadly, since 2012, Republican bigotry and vitriol has not slowed down. Trump’s MAGA Republicans have spread hatred and divisiveness around the world while Republican state legislatures are passing anti‐LGBTQ+ legislation as fast as they can. [**Peter, in 1994 when I was attacked for my identity, I lost because I didn’t have good people like you by my side. But now I do — and I’m hoping that I can count on you to chip in $7 to help me fight back against hateful Republicans and stop their anti‐LGBTQ+ agenda during the upcoming election. clean_body: my story: | = Peter, Today is National Coming Out Day and in honor of this occasion, I want to be vulnerable with you for a moment and share my personal painful story about my coming out experience. In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay with bigoted and homophobic ads to our district. I hadn’t even come out publicly yet! For members of the LGBTQ+ community, coming out is an extremely personal and sensitive moment. So, you can imagine my horror and heartbreak upon finding out I had been outed so publicly in such a hateful way. I was crushed. I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012. Peter, I’m so glad that in the face of such discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up. Now, I can fight for LGBTQ+ equality and dignity in our nation’s capital and stand up for other marginalized Americans. But sadly, since 2012, Republican bigotry and vitriol has not slowed down. [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=0e459b8455694cdf8b37f31931d4c715&_e=--UMR6Kl-B_BlORRV3GRqXQ8RSHUyFzNMyEkjSDgVGgm6INyVQ-Pn9hgF4-gx0mocOzEk63kOJHsjRIglL9cZIJptut7AYzyXWo_L77SuOF7uxuf-J3hUmhjW3UOw5FXBHjDVbdnYt18BZvHUDXxTy7Wl-EqcixvjKdvHQB79lemxangN_z8LpvdRZcqWQ_ssmFPFY1qyd5fUlmiynjZ7mrt7I6mlc8XqJiXbNxqXE4U7hqMFWiNs2w9__G5A-6pjaxQyj9kPv4_2ROWWLlWSHH7oJVXvalReQYUkAPYMLvY3ovu0-_sWSxdPl6aqQajJWgHxtIAm-C2M6yvt7Q3c6fBizInreRADSgws2Bi4dQiDKHftqbDBMIS6t_jSJ0rAXhklWna-PMde4I8744UMNxQcNUhP8DoXVXjijys7Tw%3D)

Peter,

Early voting began in Montana on Monday, and mail-in ballots are being mailed TODAY. However, due to our lack of financial resources, we’re still having trouble reaching undecided voters.

**[When I say we are running out of money every day, I mean it. name: Jill Stein
subject: We don’t need a right-wing border bill
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
This is the path to immigration justice.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=1)
---
Peter,

My team and I recently took an extended tour of the U.S.-Mexico border in Texas. We went there to document the truth and confront the flagrant lies being spread about migrants and asylum seekers.

Lies spread by BOTH Republicans and Democrats.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=2)
---
We’ve been locked in this ghoulish ratchet cycle for decades. Republicans keep dreaming up more and more violent, dehumanizing policies against immigrants – and Democrats race to embrace these policies as “bipartisan solutions” to the “immigration crisis.”

So the Republicans veer even further to the right. And the Democrats keep following them down the trail.

**Kamala Harris has chosen to make a right-wing border bill one of the central – frankly, one of the only – priorities of her campaign.

** She’s boasted that she will sign this deeply immoral bill into law as soon as she is president. She’s bragged about plans to double the number of border patrol agents and to militarize our border crossings.

Harris continuously repeats Trump’s malicious lies about migrants and drug trafficking...

She continuously repeats Republican fantasies about a massive influx of migrant crossings...

The hard fact is that apart from a distaste for certain slogans like “mass deportations,” there is no functional difference between Democratic and Republican policies on immigration.

I’m incredibly proud of the platform my team and I have mapped out, in consultation with experts, academics, and advocates, [**with**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=3)[**a vision for immigration firmly rooted in human rights and justice**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=4)[**.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=5)

[**Can you donate $25, $50 or more today to help me get this message out to undecided and disengaged voters so we can deliver our mandate at the ballot box?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=6)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=7 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=7)
---
We traveled to the border to meet with impacted communities on both sides of the fence, and to tell the truth about what needs to be done.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=8)
---
The key to the Stein-Ware administration’s approach to immigration justice is addressing the root causes of migration.

Our administration will **end our nation’s countless wars** , military interventions, and covert operations that destabilize nations and turn millions of people into refugees.

We will **vastly reduce climate migration** through an emergency Green New Deal and a rapid transition off of fossil fuels.

We will **end the senseless, wasteful, failed War on Drugs** and disempower the cartels.

We will grant **amnesty to ALL undocumented persons** and implement a **rapid path to citizenship** to end the emotional anguish and bureaucratic morass of having millions of Americans trapped in legal limbo.

We will **ensure that immigration courts have the proper resources** needed to swiftly process asylum cases and eliminate the strain on border communities impacted by long waits.

Indisputably, there ARE problems with our immigration system. But those problems are entirely self-inflicted and can be fixed. Our campaign is the ONLY one with a comprehensive, human-centered plan to do so.

**[Election Day is only 25 days away. There are still millions of people who are disengaged and unwilling to vote for Trump OR Harris, knowing that neither represents their priorities. We can inspire them to vote Green, but we need your help to reach them and time is running short.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/wall?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=immigration_justice&n=9)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---

Fellow American,

I wish I could have this one back...

**_Republican Challenger, Royce White, Loses 2022 Election as Squad Leader Ilhan Omar Reclaims Minnesota-05._**
This might be the hardest email I’ve ever written.

**I’m Royce White, the first U.S. Senate Candidate born in the 1990s. If I win, I could be the first Black Senator representing Minnesotans in U.S. history.**
